records.title: Two-dimensional material membranes with precisely tunable interlayer spacing from nanometre to submillimetre
records.description: A deprotonation–ion coordination strategy is developed for microstructural engineering of layered material membranes, enabling the precise and reversible modulation of interlayer spacing over five orders of magnitude.

records.title: Controlling the flow of information in optical metrology
records.description: By treating Fisher information as a conserved wave quantity, nanophotonic systems can be designed to control information generation and flow, opening a route to improve optical measurement and sensing precision.

records.title: Proximal redox coupling enables oxidation damping for stable water electrolysis
records.description: Single-atom catalysts can mitigate reliance on scarce noble metals, but isolated sites can be fragile. Here a catalyst with proximal Ru−O−Cr motifs is fabricated that demonstrates proximal oxidation damping where the Cr neighbour buffers Ru overoxidation, improving stability for acidic oxygen evolution.

records.title: Nonlinear waveguide polaritons for long-distance propagation of spins at room temperature
records.description: In spintronics, the spin of particles is used to transfer information but the propagation distances are short, whereas photons carry spin further but lack the nonlinear interactions necessary for logic gates. Now, polariton waveguides built from transition metal dichalcogenides enable spin propagation of up to 100 μm at room temperature and maintain large polariton nonlinearities.

records.title: Soft polymer coatings form hard directional bonding
records.description: Soft polymer coatings spontaneously rearrange on nanosphere surfaces to form directional bonds, unlocking an alternative route to delicate nanoparticle superlattices.

records.title: Spin order steers a light–matter condensate
records.description: Light–matter condensates get a magnetic control knob. In the layered magnet CrSBr, reorienting the spins with a modest field shifts the condensate’s colour by more than 10 meV.

records.title: Imaging multi-particle dynamics in space and time
records.description: The simultaneous presence of multiple (quasi)particles is a challenge for ultrafast imaging. Measurement at a few intensities disentangles the single- and multi-particle spatiotemporal dynamics.

records.title: Nanoparticles as carrier and drug
records.description: A lipid nanoparticle formulation degrades an immunosuppressive receptor on tumour-associated macrophages through its lipids alone, while its messenger RNA cargo reprograms these cells in situ into anti-tumour chimeric antigen receptor macrophages, reshaping the immune microenvironment of malignant ascites in gastrointestinal cancer.

records.title: In situ CAR engineering and nanoparticle-mediated TREM2 degradation for macrophage reprogramming in malignant ascites
records.description: Targeted lipid nanoparticles reprogram TREM2 + -tumour-associated macrophages in ascitic fluid into chimeric antigen receptor macrophage cells, providing an in situ cell engineering strategy that alters the tumour microenvironment and promotes tumour cell elimination in rodent models.

records.title: Spatiotemporal intensity-cycling microscopy unveils many-body interactions and correlated transport in van der Waals semiconductors
records.description: Intensity-cycling spatiotemporal microscopy separates single-particle and multi-particle transport, enabling imaging of charge mobility, exciton interactions, and correlated many-body states in van der Waals semiconductors, including Mott transitions.

records.title: Mechanical adaptation drives out-of-equilibrium network reorganization and self-strengthening in adapt-ring networks
records.description: Adapt-ring networks consisting of dense, reconfigurable α-cyclodextrin crystalline domains and sparsely crosslinked polyethylene glycol form adaptive polymer materials that remodel and strengthen in response to mechanical stress.

records.title: Model systems and integration strategies to capture human biology
records.description: Predictive human-relevant model systems are outlined in a Review by integrating engineered materials and microenvironments, human tissue and organ models, computational approaches, and closed-loop strategies. Controlling the boundary conditions, biological organization, measurements and model calibration can improve mechanistic insight, reproducibility and translational relevance across applications.

records.title: Breaking symmetry in nanoparticle superlattices via spontaneous valency
records.description: The deformation of flexible ligands in polymer-grafted nanoparticles enables initially isotropic particles to produce effective valency, accessing lattice symmetries with unexpected deviations from densest packing or highest coordination number.

records.title: Spin currents in polariton waveguides driven by bright and dark excitons
records.description: Non-resonant excitation of WS 2 in-plane microcavities generates waveguide exciton–polaritons that carry spin-polarized currents over distances exceeding 90 μm at room temperature and reveal a non-resonantly pumped optical spin Hall effect.

records.title: Process-intrinsic cellular network for sustained strength–ductility across temperatures in a 3D-printed multi-principal-element alloy
records.description: Laser-based additive manufacturing enables the formation of a self-assembled precipitate cellular network in a multi-principal element alloy, which sustains a yield strength above 1 GPa and a uniform elongation of approximately 20% over a wide temperature range.

records.title: Writing monolayer oxides with electrons
records.description: Layered metal oxyhalides can be selectively dehalogenated inside a scanning transmission electron microscope, yielding free-standing monolayer oxide sheets and coupling synthesis with atomic-resolution observation.

records.title: Topological control of polaritonic flatbands in anisotropic van der Waals metasurfaces
records.description: Photonic metasurfaces patterned in anisotropic ReS 2 create robust, spectrally scalable directional photonic flatbands, enabling the topological control of polarization-resolved exciton–polaritons and enhanced light–matter coupling.

records.title: Free-standing two-dimensional metal oxides at the single-atomic-layer limit
records.description: The electron-beam-assisted subtraction method enables the controllable fabrication of free-standing metal oxide monolayers, along with lateral heterostructures and twisted bilayers, expanding the material space of 2D quantum systems.

records.title: Engineering therapeutic delivery
records.description: Lipid nanoparticles are increasingly adept at delivering therapeutics to specific tissues and cell types, and, in some cases, the nanoparticles themselves can now modulate cellular behaviour, immune function and therapeutic outcome.

records.title: Lipid nanoparticles call the shots as mRNA medicine takes off
records.description: The therapeutic potential of mRNA had been on the radar for decades but it took an alliance with lipid nanoparticle research to make it a reality. Researchers are now looking for ways to better increase efficacy and reduce side effects to extend the potential of the delivery agents from vaccines to pulmonary and neurological interventions.

records.title: Direct imaging elucidates ionic memory in two-dimensional nanochannels
records.description: The microscopic origin of ionic memory in two-dimensional (2D) nanofluidic memristors remains debated. Voltage-induced blistering of the confining walls of 2D nanofluidic channels is identified to trigger memristive hysteresis leading to nonlinear ion transport in the channels.

records.title: III-nitride-based in-sensor computing enabled by interfacial polarization effects
records.description: Intrinsic electric polarization in III-nitride semiconductors is an advantage for large-scale optoelectronic devices but remains largely unexplored in sensory-memristive devices. Polarization-induced spatial separation of photogenerated carriers at the interfaces of III-nitride heterostructures enables efficient and scalable in-sensor computing at room temperature.

records.title: Strain turns carbon dioxide into circular polyesters
records.description: The high ring strain of cyclic hydrocarbons enables alternating copolymerization with carbon dioxide to produce polyesters amenable to closed-loop recycling.

records.title: Zero-field spin-wave networks with integrated non-volatile memory
records.description: Ferrimagnetic nanostructures with low spin-wave damping are used to demonstrate the reprogrammable routing of spin-wave signals across a wide range of frequencies.

records.title: Genes take control of active matter
records.description: Gene expression reconstituted outside the cell controls the composition and dynamics of cytoskeletal networks, bringing the tools of synthetic biology to active matter and opening a route to genetically programmed biomaterials.

records.title: Bridging microwaves and light
records.description: Strong coupling between magnons and excitons in CrSBr enables microwave-to-optical transduction, offering a route towards efficient conversion between otherwise disparate frequency regimes.

records.title: Bioresorbable metal-free molecular magnets enable untethered organ monitoring
records.description: A bioresorbable, metal-free molecular magnet for wireless deep-tissue sensing is reported that enables continuous cardiac monitoring and injectable organ tracking in vivo before the material safely degrades.

records.title: Molecular weaving goes multilevel
records.description: Integrating distinct weaving topologies within a single molecular network creates coupled deformation modes and adaptive adsorption behaviour, pointing to a shift from constructing molecular topologies to exploiting them for functions.

records.title: Taking the heat off tantalum
records.description: Krypton-assisted growth of low-loss α-phase tantalum on silicon stays within back-end-of-line semiconductor thermal budgets while delivering state-of-the-art qubit coherence.

records.title: Magnetic control of an exciton–polariton condensate in a van der Waals magnet
records.description: Magnetically tunable exciton–polariton condensation is demonstrated in CrSBr, a van der Waals magnet, using microwires embedded in an optical cavity under photoexcitation. The observation may enable ultrafast control of condensate emission through coupling to coherent magnons.

records.title: Gene-driven self-morphing microtubule-based active matter
records.description: Cell-free gene expression is embedded directly within a microtubule network to generate a genetically programmed active material with complementary biochemical and physical controls.

records.title: Ultrafast anisotropic valleytronics in SnSe
records.description: Polarization-selective excitation in SnSe reveals anisotropic valley dynamics with distinct channels: one channel with near-unity valley polarization and one channel that rapidly depolarizes through electron–phonon-mediated intervalley scattering.

records.title: Loss-reshaped asymmetric nanolight
records.description: Optical loss is usually treated as a limitation. An electrically tunable carbon-nanotube layer instead uses directional dissipation to reshape nanoscale polariton propagation.

records.title: Chemically moulding intermetallics in two dimensions
records.description: An adsorption–conversion strategy enables the synthesis of ultrathin intermetallics across a broad compositional space, from binaries to high-entropy alloys.

records.title: Single-stripe magnetic order and bilayer spin dynamics in single-crystalline La 3 Ni 2 O 7
records.description: Momentum-resolved neutron scattering of a mosaic of single crystals of La 3 Ni 2 O 7 , a parent compound of nickelate superconductors, is reported. The magnetic behaviour of these nickelate crystals is distinct from that of cuprates and furthers our understanding of the origin of superconductivity in this class of materials.

records.title: Polarization vortices in a ferromagnetic metal via twistronics
records.description: Polar topological states are realized in stacked and twisted 10-nm-thick metallic ferromagnetic SrRuO 3 membranes, and their emergence is attributed to flexoelectric effects arising from shear strain gradients.

records.title: Ionic feedback enables programmable event-driven organic photosensing
records.description: An organic mixed ionic–electronic photosensor is developed that converts changes in illumination into transient current spikes and uses ion-mediated inhibition to program their amplitude. This in-sensor amplitude–temporal coding preserves motion-relevant information before readout, enabling spatial event weighting and energy-efficient neuromorphic visual processing in device-informed simulations.

records.title: Amplitude-controllable event-driven organic photosensors based on ionic-mediated inhibition
records.description: Conventional photosensors typically require multitransistor architecture to achieve fast temporal response and adaptive sensory gain to mimic biological vision. An organic mixed ionic–electronic photosensor is developed to enable temporal-contrast detection and analogue amplitude control within a single active layer, realizing efficient event-driven neuromorphic vision.

records.title: Probing orbital occupation at atomic resolution
records.description: A real-space method of measuring electron linear dichroism provides atomic column-resolved information on orbital occupancy, which is key to understanding strain and charge transfer effects at defects and interfaces.

records.title: Controllable gene delivery via masked adeno-associated viral vectors
records.description: Masked adeno-associated viruses are developed that remain inactive until they are unmasked by disease-related signals or near-infrared light, enabling localized gene delivery to the liver, muscle, brain and injured heart in mice.

records.title: Probing orbital occupation at atomic resolution
records.description: A real-space method of measuring electron linear dichroism provides atomic column-resolved information on orbital occupancy, which is key to understanding strain and charge transfer effects at defects and interfaces.

records.title: Controllable gene delivery via masked adeno-associated viral vectors
records.description: Masked adeno-associated viruses are developed that remain inactive until they are unmasked by disease-related signals or near-infrared light, enabling localized gene delivery to the liver, muscle, brain and injured heart in mice.

records.title: Adaptive integration of bioelectronics
records.description: Future bioelectronics depend not only on developing and improving device functions, but also on designing materials and delivery strategies that adapt to living environments.

records.title: The surface addresses the interconnect challenge
records.description: Single-crystalline cobalt monosilicide shows enhanced electrical conductivity with decreasing size at the nanoscale, providing potential as an alternative interconnect to copper.

records.title: Electrical control of perpendicular altermagnets
records.description: An altermagnet/Dirac semimetal heterostructure enables electrical switching and reading of an altermagnetic Néel vector oriented perpendicular to the film, a configuration previously forbidden by magnetic symmetry.

records.title: Sub-10-nm stacking bands enable ultrastrong additively manufactured titanium
records.description: Integrating laser powder bed fusion with a high-throughput screening and machine learning method identifies a processing–composition regime for fabricating Ti alloys with sub-10-nm stacking bands, which present high specific strength and potential for scalable manufacturing.

records.title: Rapid-responsive and water-stable organic electrochemical transistors enabled by supramolecular artificial ion channels
records.description: The slow response and water instability of current organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) hinder their in vivo applications. OECTs with a layer of assembled stacks of crown ethers within a water-resistant polymer show fast response and stability, achieving real-time, high-fidelity monitoring of neural activities under physiological conditions.

records.title: Inoculating lithium against dendrites
records.description: A grain refinement approach that involves Mg–1 wt% La inoculants is shown to delay void growth, enabling high critical current density and high-rate solid-state lithium metal batteries.

records.title: Multilevel molecular weaving
records.description: Molecular weaving provides a bottom-up strategy for topological control of materials properties. Here, multiple woven topologies are incorporated in a single two-dimensional polymer network through the regulation of monomer size and solvent templating.

records.title: Adsorption–conversion synthesis of ultrathin intermetallics and high-entropy alloys
records.description: An adsorption–conversion strategy enables the synthesis of ultrathin intermetallic compounds and high-entropy metallic alloys with highly tunable compositions, exhibiting compelling electrical and magnetic properties.

records.title: Interlayer hybridization promotes superconductivity in bilayer nickelates
records.description: Spectroscopic studies on a series of bilayer nickelate (La,Pr) 3 Ni 2 O 7 thin films with insulating, metallic and superconducting ground states are presented and it is concluded that superconductivity emerges when coherent \({d}_{{z}^{2}}-{p}_{z}-{d}_{{z}^{2}}\) interlayer hybridization develops.

records.title: Funding the new
records.description: Nicola Spaldin, professor of materials theory at ETH Zurich and vice-president for physical sciences and engineering at the European Research Council (ERC), talks to Nature Material s about the ERC, the grants they oversee and the objectives of the new ERC Plus grant.

records.title: Reconfigurable non-Abelian braiding of nematic bits
records.description: Reconfigurable non-Abelian braiding is implemented in a nematic liquid crystal system, bridging soft-matter physics and topological information processing.

records.title: Excitons driving spin dynamics in CrSBr
records.description: Photoexcited excitons in the two-dimensional antiferromagnet CrSBr are found to act as a source of spin torque, driving nonlinear magnon dynamics through phase-coherent energy exchange that persists well beyond the optical pulse.

records.title: Application-driven development of metal–organic frameworks
records.description: To increase the technological value of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) and promote their translation into real-world applications, societal needs, market interests and industry requirements need to be considered early on in MOF research and development.

records.title: Materials design for biocompatible electronics
records.description: Xuanhe Zhao, a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, talks to Nature Materials about the considerations of mechanical and materials properties to achieve biocompatible and stable bioelectronics.

records.title: Microwave-to-optical transduction using magnon–exciton coupling
records.description: Broadband microwave-to-optical conversion is demonstrated in the layered antiferromagnet CrSBr through strong magnon–exciton coupling, offering a scalable platform for quantum transduction.

records.title: Doping by degradation
records.description: A p-type dopant whose radical anion decomposes after electron transfer can continuously maintain the doping reaction and boost hole densities by orders of magnitude.

records.title: Weaving braids of defect lines
records.description: Colloidal particles steered by light weave the defect lines of a nematic liquid crystal into programmable crossings, realizing non-Abelian braiding operations that can be watched, reordered and compiled in real space.

records.title: Molecular modifier aids melting of MOFs
records.description: The glass transition temperatures of melting mixtures of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) and phenanthroline are lowered through transient coordination, enabling melt-quenched vitrification of previously unmeltable MOFs.

records.title: A boost for CAR T cell therapy
records.description: A polymer lipid nanoparticle carrier passively targets, activates and transfects T cells in vivo with chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) mRNA for fibrosis therapy.

records.title: Single-crystalline CoSi semimetals with high conductivity and reliability
records.description: The electrical resistivity of conventional copper interconnects increases as their dimensions decrease. In contrast, the resistivity of CoSi nanoflakes decreases as their thickness is reduced from 1 μm to ∼20 nm. These nanoflakes demonstrate high reliability and serve as promising interconnects at the nanoscale.

records.title: Electrically programmable polariton symmetry breaking via non-Hermitian dissipation engineering
records.description: Reversible tuning of polariton topology in α-MoO 3 /aligned carbon nanotube heterostructures is achieved through gate-tunable anisotropic dissipation, with the aligned carbon nanotube layer operating as a momentum-space loss filter.

records.title: Ultrahigh pressure phase transition in ice
records.description: The crystal structure of ice X is observed to distort under extreme pressure at room temperature before transforming to ice XXII, the most dense H 2 O polymorph experimentally observed.

records.title: Electric-field switching of g -wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO 3
records.description: Electric-field switching of g -wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO 3 membranes is demonstrated using circularly dichroic resonant inelastic X-ray scattering.

records.title: Octahedral connectivity reconfigures interfacial carrier-selective properties for efficient perovskite solar cells
records.description: Regulating interfacial properties helps to improve the performance of perovskite solar cells but requires extrinsic chemical doping. A strategy based on an organic-cation-induced reconfiguration of lead iodide octahedral connectivity effectively regulates the carrier-selective interface without extrinsic dopants, achieving efficient and stable solar cells.

records.title: A chlorinated organic cation enables stable 2D/3D tin iodide perovskite photovoltaics
records.description: The air instability and uncontrolled crystallization of tin halide perovskites have hindered their photovoltaic applications. Two-dimensional tin perovskites containing the 4-chloro-phenethylammonium cation are developed to enable durable tin halide perovskite solar cells capable of achieving 16.2% efficiency and over 1,000 h of operational stability at 55 °C in ambient air.

records.title: The meta way of thinking
records.description: Beyond enabling new optical behaviours, metamaterials influence our thinking of wave–matter interactions in science and engineering.

records.title: Semiconducting polymers assembled to perfection
records.description: Single-crystalline polymers with remarkable long-range order and charge carrier mobilities are fabricated by regulating solution-state aggregates and assembly pathways.

records.title: Tuning moiré twist angles enhances tensile plasticity in bulk van der Waals crystals
records.description: Interlayer moiré twisting in bulk layered van der waals crystals is controllably introduced through off-axis compression and substantially enhances the room-temperature macroscopic tensile ductility of the layered crystals.

records.title: Neural network finds twisted crystals that steer light at the nanoscale
records.description: Light propagation can be controlled at the nanoscale by forming surface polaritons in two-dimensional layers of van der Waals crystals stacked with a relative twist. Now, a neural network that works backwards from a target light path identifies structures that produce a desired propagation across visible to terahertz operating frequencies.

records.title: From invention to industrialization of materials in Europe
records.description: The materials sector in Europe is renowned for its research excellence but scale-up and industrialization of materials is less successful. The 2026 Advanced Materials Act is an opportunity to structurally reposition Europe in the global materials economy.

records.title: Deep learning design of nanoscale polariton propagations in twisted van der Waals multilayers
records.description: Neural-network-guided design of twisted multilayer van der Waals materials enables on-demand control of polariton canalization across the visible, infrared and terahertz spectral regions.

records.title: Ultrahigh-ratio drawing during spinning achieves graphene fibres with high strength and thermal conductivity
records.description: Polymer-like viscoelasticity of two-dimensional graphene oxide in viscous solvents enables ultrahigh-ratio drawing during fibre spinning, which achieves macroscopic graphene fibres with a compelling combination of high mechanical strength, thermal conductivity and electrical conductivity.

records.title: Controlling ferroelectric-like gating in two‑dimensional stacks
records.description: Graphene encapsulated in hexagonal boron nitride sometimes shows a puzzling ferroelectric-like memory effect. A rotatable device reveals that this effect can be turned on and off by twisting the two hexagonal boron nitride layers away from perfect alignment, resolving debates and raising fundamental questions about the microscopic origin of interface polarity in twisted van der Waals stacks.

records.title: Triggering conversion in vanadium electrodes
records.description: Using transition metals efficiently in aqueous batteries requires transferring multiple electrons per metal, which leads to difficult-to-manage conversion reactions. It is now shown how vanadium can be changed from one-electron insertion to four-electron conversion.

records.title: Magneto-optics marches on
records.description: Continued developments in materials synthesis and light sources are driving the discovery of magneto-optical phenomena.

records.title: Void suppressive lithium anodes for all-solid-state batteries
records.description: The kinetics and thermodynamics of void formation are investigated in all-solid-state lithium metal batteries and found to be controlled by interfacial lithium concentration and diffusivity. Diffusivity can be increased using a grain-refining approach, by introducing a Mg–1 wt% La inoculant in the melt, enabling a critical current density of 2.2 mA cm − 2 at 1.1 mAh cm − 2 .

records.title: Crystal nucleation and growth in high-entropy alloys revealed by atomic electron tomography
records.description: Atomic electron tomography resolves nucleation and growth in multi-principal-element alloy nanoparticles, revealing gradient structural ordering coupled to the local chemical order.

records.title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via a proximitized Dirac semimetal
records.description: Electrical switching and reading of perpendicular altermagnetic order is demonstrated in a Dirac semimetal/altermagnet heterostructure PtTe 2 /CrSb. The switching of altermagnetic CrSb is realized using a spin–orbit torque generated in the PtTe 2 layer on application of an electrical current, whereas the reading makes use of an altermagnetic proximity-induced anomalous Hall effect in the PtTe 2 layer.

records.title: Crystal nucleation and growth in high-entropy alloys revealed by atomic electron tomography
records.description: Atomic electron tomography resolves nucleation and growth in multi-principal-element alloy nanoparticles, revealing gradient structural ordering coupled to the local chemical order.

records.title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via a proximitized Dirac semimetal
records.description: Electrical switching and reading of perpendicular altermagnetic order is demonstrated in a Dirac semimetal/altermagnet heterostructure PtTe 2 /CrSb. The switching of altermagnetic CrSb is realized using a spin–orbit torque generated in the PtTe 2 layer on application of an electrical current, whereas the reading makes use of an altermagnetic proximity-induced anomalous Hall effect in the PtTe 2 layer.

records.title: Flux-mediated ligand exchange restructures metal–organic framework glasses
records.description: The organic ligand phenanthroline acts as a flux to vitrify otherwise non-glass-forming metal–organic frameworks as well as restructuring the coordination environment and network topology of the resulting glasses and tuning properties (such as magnetism).

records.title: Reticular chemistry mimics enzyme pockets
records.description: Two metal–organic frameworks, built from the same node and differing only in the twist of their tritopic linker, reorient metal sites while leaving chemistry, porosity and topology unchanged, showing that confinement can be programmed by design: the more confined framework captures nearly four times as much CO 2 from air.

records.title: From equilibrium to ultrafast antiferromagnetism
records.description: This Review presents a symmetry-based classification of antiferromagnetism and discusses the progress and challenges in detecting, exciting and probing the dynamics of antiferromagnets.

records.title: Intranasal vaccines by precision printing
records.description: Three-dimensional DNA origami nanocarriers with surface-patterned antigens exhibit enhanced mucosal retention and trigger potent, localized respiratory immunity against respiratory syncytial virus.

records.title: Bridging ambient- and high-pressure superconductivity in La 2 LnNi 2 O 7 films
records.description: Lanthanide substitution, ultrahigh magnetic field measurements and high-pressure studies are utilized to compare and contrast ambient- and high-pressure superconductivity in bilayer nickelate films.

records.title: Krypton-sputtered tantalum films for scalable high-performance quantum devices
records.description: Krypton sputtering is found to promote the synthesis of body-centred-cubic tantalum films on silicon at temperatures as low as 200 °C, compatible with back-end-of-line fabrication standards. Superconducting qubits based on these thin films exhibit excellent performance.

records.title: An aberration-corrected bionic eye for full-colour vision and event-driven motion detection
records.description: A bionic eye system based on a hemispherical tandem retina combines practical resolution, wide-band colour vision, self-powered motion detection and computational efficiency.

records.title: Layer-engineered quantum anomalous Hall effect in twisted rhombohedral graphene
records.description: Magnetotransport measurements on numerous samples of monolayer–multilayer (1 + N ) rhombohedral graphene reveal a high-Chern-number quantum anomalous Hall effect with Chern number C = N . Further, in twisted Bernal bilayer–rhombohedral tetralayer graphene, a displacement-field-driven topological phase transition between C = 3 and C = 4 states is demonstrated.

records.title: Degradation-assisted doping of organic semiconductors enabled by Lewis acids
records.description: Electrical doping is commonly used in organic optoelectronics to tune the electronic properties. A mechanism using unstable radical anions of p-doping agents increases the hole densities in the organic semiconductor host by up to two orders of magnitude compared with regular p-dopants.

records.title: An inherent T cell-activating mRNA delivery carrier for in vivo CAR T generation
records.description: A ligand-free polymer–lipid mRNA nanoparticle with inherent T cell-activating capacity enables in vivo T cell engineering and transient chimeric antigen receptor T cell generation to deplete pathogenic fibroblasts in cancer and fibrosis models.

records.title: Topology-guided vortices in a polariton condensate
records.description: A perovskite quasi-bound state in the continuum metasurface with broken in-plane inversion symmetry generates topology-driven spin polaritons, in which condensation and spin–orbit coupled half-vortex pairs are governed by the cavity geometry.

records.title: Controlling surface kinetics scales p-type two-dimensional semiconductors
records.description: The precise control of surface and near-surface atomic kinetics produces environmentally stable p-type two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors at wafer scale, providing a pathway for the manufacture of scalable 2D complementary electronics.

records.title: Goniopolar kagome materials boost transverse thermoelectricity
records.description: Thermoelectricity enables interconversion between heat and charge currents, but existing material platforms rely on constrained longitudinal geometries, complex fabrication or an external magnetic field to achieve high performance. Now, goniopolar kagome materials enable strong transversal thermoelectricity without an applied magnetic field, owing to flat electronic bands or van Hove singularities.

records.title: Microdroplets jam together to mimic soft tissues
records.description: Densely packed emulsions compartmentalized by droplet interface bilayers enable high-throughput production and printing of biomimetic synthetic tissues.

records.title: Twisting light the Weyl way
records.description: The application of a magnetic field to a Mn(Bi,Sb) 2 Te 4 alloy induces concurrent magnetic and topological phase transitions, giving rise to unexpectedly strong circular dichroism in the infrared range.

records.title: Two is company and three is a quantum interface
records.description: Magnetic-field-resilient granular aluminium mediates nonlinear interactions in a microwave cavity–magnon system, enabling tripartite entanglement with implications for quantum transduction and detection.

records.title: Molecular engineering of self-assembled layers
records.description: A spacer-engineered molecule helps to stabilize the buried hole-transport interface and enhances assembly density to realize perovskite solar cells that are resistant to ultraviolet and thermal stress.

records.title: An alloy that can take the heat and the hit
records.description: A hierarchically heterostructured high-entropy alloy combines bimodal core–shell grains, nanoprecipitates and oxide particles that remain stable up to 1,000 °C, delivering 2.2 GPa yield strength under high strain-rate loading without sacrificing impact toughness.

records.title: Molecular coordination achieves uniform kesterite absorber film for efficient solar modules
records.description: Challenges in the preparation of uniform large-area kesterite Cu 2 ZnSn(S,Se) 4 (CZTSSe) thin films have hindered the scalability of related solar cells. A molecular-level regulation of metal–organic coordination achieves uniform selenization and crystallization, allowing formation of homogeneous CZTSSe thin films over 10 cm 2 , leading to efficient kesterite solar cells and modules.

records.title: Microbiota matter
records.description: Gut microbiota shapes nanomedicine fate by regulating hepatic clearance, with implications for tumour delivery.

records.title: A transferable gut microbiota–bile acid pathway programs nanomedicine pharmacokinetics and therapeutic response
records.description: A gut microbiota–bile acid pathway is identified that controls the liver clearance of nanomedicines, thereby improving drug delivery to tumours and cancer treatment responses.

records.title: Organic synapses with programmable linearity for neuromorphic computing
records.description: Interfacial effects and nonlinear electronic processes hinder the development of high-performance organic artificial synapses. A highly efficient organic all-photonic synapse is developed with linear synaptic responses achieved by optically tailored charge-separation kinetics.

records.title: 3D-printed implantable bioelectronics enabled by anti-swelling and biphasic conductive hydrogels
records.description: Hydrogel bioelectronics typically fail mechanically and electrically because of swelling in wet conditions. An anti-swelling hydrogel with minimal foreign-body reactions is reported and engineered into a supporting matrix and biphasic conductive ink, enabling the embedded 3D printing of implantable bioelectronics.

records.title: Fermiology-driven goniopolar transverse thermoelectricity in kagome metals
records.description: Axis-dependent carrier polarity, in combination with flat-band and van Hove singularity states, enable transverse thermopower of 18.4 μV K −1 and transverse Peltier conductivity of 105 A m −1 K −1 at room temperature and zero field in LuCo 6 Ge 6 .

records.title: Intercalated conductive fibres
Intercalate to modulate
records.description: Intercalation at van der Waals interfaces enables atomic- or molecular-scale engineering of two-dimensional materials, transforming approaches for their synthesis and functionalization.

records.title: Fast interlayer exciton drift driven by lattice reconstruction in a van der Waals heterobilayer
records.description: Time-resolved measurements of interlayer exciton transport in van der Waals heterobilayers show that lattice reconstruction generates potential energy gradients, driving rapid exciton drift towards low-energy recombination sites.

records.title: Modular synthesis of chemically programmable superlattices
records.description: Intercalants confined between two-dimensional atomic layers can self-assemble into ordered interlayer structures, giving rise to well-defined intercalated superlattices that offer chemically programmable functionalities. This Review classifies the building blocks used to construct such functional intercalated superlattices and examines the key challenges as well as emerging strategies for their synthesis and assembly.

records.title: Watch the interfacial gap
How hydrogen damages Ni-based superalloys in the heat
records.description: Hydrogen compromises the mechanical performance of metallic materials, but hydrogen–material interactions at high temperatures remain poorly understood despite emerging applications in hydrogen-powered energy systems. Now, multiscale damage analysis of Ni-based superalloys tested in a high-temperature hydrogen atmosphere uncovers degradation mechanisms that differ from those operating at near-room temperature.

records.title: Non-reciprocal linearly polarized light in simple media
records.description: Directional asymmetry in light absorption and emission emerges in simple materials from the interplay of chirality and linear anisotropy.

records.title: Force-responsive biomaterials drive tissue repair by harnessing endogenous growth factors
records.description: Aptamer constructs attached to biomaterial scaffolds promote tissue repair by the harvesting and cell-activated delivery of endogenous growth factors from cells and injury sites, and are able to modulate cell responses at physiologically relevant doses.

records.title: Hydrogen-induced damage in Ni-based superalloys at elevated temperatures
records.description: Hydrogen embrittlement in Ni-based alloys at elevated temperatures is shown to differ fundamentally from that at ambient conditions. The high temperature promotes vacancy-mediated hydrogen trapping and chemical reactions at the carbide–matrix interface, resulting in pronounced embrittlement.

records.title: Van der Waals surface reconstruction for oriented epitaxial growth of two-dimensional metallic oxides
records.description: Large-scale growth of various two-dimensional metallic oxides with high crystalline quality is achieved via mica surface-reconstruction-assisted van der Waals epitaxy, enabling their exploration in quantum physics and spintronic applications.

records.title: Entanglements enable circular engineering plastics
records.description: An entanglement-dominated design strategy combines dense physical chain entanglements with sparse trigger-cleavable covalent crosslinks. This strategy enables high-performance thermosets with generation-invariant regeneration, opening an avenue for circular engineering plastics.

records.title: Jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions as 3D-printable biological tissue mimics
records.description: The scalable formation of jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions provides a platform for replicating structural and functional properties of biological tissues.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Quantum control of Hubbard excitons
One-step etch and peel
Liquid metal and silicon unite
records.description: Interfacing liquid metal with silicon nanomembranes is realized by using a titanium barrier to prevent gallium from leaching out of the eutectic gallium indium liquid metal, achieving visual acquisition and depth sensing with a liquid-metal-based circuit array.

records.title: Two parallel phosphorus economies
records.description: Paul Westerhoff and Jacob Jones discuss how the unique chemistry of phosphorus enables technologies beyond agricultural fertilizers, ranging from batteries to semiconductors and quantum materials.

records.title: Topological piezoelectricity in bulk ferroelectrics
records.description: The piezoelectric response of Pb(Mg 1 /3 Nb 2/3 )O 3 –PbTiO 3 crystals is enhanced through engineering of the vortex domain density.

records.title: Author Correction: Plasmonic printing of high-performance metal oxide electronics under room temperature
Author Correction: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
Unconventional skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets
records.description: Skyrmions with opposite core polarity are found to form in a single sublattice of a compensated synthetic antiferromagnet, offering a route to programmable, layer-selective three-dimensional spin textures.

records.title: Shining light in deep tissue
records.description: Mechanoluminescent nanomaterials administered in the bloodstream enable ultrasound-controlled light emission and deep-tissue optogenetic stimulation of neurons.

records.title: Mechanical regulation of immunity in metastasis
records.description: Mechanical cues regulate both metastatic dissemination and antitumour immunity. Integrating these processes through mechano-immunology may provide a framework to understand metastatic progression.

records.title: In situ scattering optical microscopy offers power in numbers with single-particle precision
records.description: An in situ microscopy technique monitors the size and luminescent properties of thousands of individual nanocrystals within minutes, uncovering size-dependent phenomena in the life cycle of semiconductor nanocrystals.

records.title: Fluoride ions as charge carriers in electrochemical energy storage
records.description: Lithium-ion batteries are commonplace, but large-scale production leads to potential materials criticality constraints. This Review discusses fluoride-anion systems as a potential alternative, outlining design principles for electrodes, materials design concepts, degradation mechanisms and research fronts that must be considered.

records.title: Design principles for π -conjugated hydrogel semiconductors
records.description: The semiconducting behaviour in hydrogels enables advanced electronic applications for biosystems. This Review provides key principles of the design, fabrication, characterizations and benchmarking for π -conjugated hydrogel semiconductors.

records.title: Author Correction: Mechanisms of active wetting and fluidification in epithelial cell collectives
Wafer-scale growth of highly stable p-type semiconducting monolayer MoSi 2 N 4 single crystals
records.description: Wafer-scale monolayer single crystals of p-type semiconducting MoSi 2 N 4 are grown via chemical vapour deposition, and exhibit high mobility and stability.

records.title: Switching from insertion to conversion for multielectron aqueous vanadium batteries
records.description: Conventional aqueous vanadium-ion batteries have low capacities, as the fundamental charge-storage mechanism is a one-electron insertion process. Here, using a mesoporous carbon shell approach, a four-electron conversion reaction for charge storage is demonstrated.

records.title: Twist-angle-controlled anomalous gating in bilayer graphene/BN heterostructures
records.description: Rotational misalignment between the top and bottom boron nitride layers encapsulating graphene acts as a switch for anomalous gating effects, such as gate ineffectiveness and hysteresis. These effects are observed at room temperature within an angle range of 15–45° and are highly sensitive to small angular changes.

records.title: Engineered living materials need engineered EU regulation
records.description: Kai Purnhagen and Justus Wesseler discuss how EU law needs reform to address market access bottlenecks for living composites.

records.title: Multimodal scanning-probe quantum sensing of quantum materials
records.description: Solid-state spin defects are a powerful and versatile class of quantum sensor. This Review covers the development of scanning-probe nitrogen-vacancy sensing as a tool for investigating quantum materials with nanoscale resolution, surveys the recent development of spin defects in 1D and 2D host materials and identifies key directions for future research.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Ultralow-voltage electrochemical organic light-emitting transistors with pinned and wide lateral recombination
Excitons in van der Waals magnetic materials
records.description: In this Review, the interplay of excitons, magnons and photons in two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors and how this enables control of light–matter interactions are discussed, and promising opportunities for magneto-optic optoelectronic and quantum applications are surveyed.

records.title: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
records.description: Triazolate metal–organic frameworks with Zn 5 Cl 4 nodes are formed with terminal Zn-bound groups pointing inwards, creating tunable confined pores. Post-synthetic chloride-to-hydroxide exchange yields dense Zn–OH sites, enabling reversible CO 2 chemisorption and low-pressure CO 2 capture.

records.title: Excitons in van der Waals magnetic materials
records.description: In this Review, the interplay of excitons, magnons and photons in two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors and how this enables control of light–matter interactions are discussed, and promising opportunities for magneto-optic optoelectronic and quantum applications are surveyed.

records.title: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
records.description: Triazolate metal–organic frameworks with Zn 5 Cl 4 nodes are formed with terminal Zn-bound groups pointing inwards, creating tunable confined pores. Post-synthetic chloride-to-hydroxide exchange yields dense Zn–OH sites, enabling reversible CO 2 chemisorption and low-pressure CO 2 capture.

records.title: Fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect in moiré fractional Chern insulators
records.description: The fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect serves as the defining experimental manifestation of fractional Chern insulators at zero magnetic field. This Perspective surveys its realization in moiré materials, examines underlying mechanisms and outlines pathways towards new fractional and non-Abelian topological states.

records.title: Single-crystal-like polymer semiconductors via self-templated gradient assembly for ultrahigh charge carrier mobility
records.description: High-performance polymer semiconductors are required for next-generation organic electronics. A strategy that modulates multi-scale structural ordering and controls the alignment of polymers yields single-crystal-like semiconducting polymers with notably improved charge mobility.

records.title: High-Chern-number orbital magnetism in twisted rhombohedral graphene
records.description: Magnetotransport measurements and mean-field calculations of twisted monolayer–multilayer (1 + n ) rhombohedral graphene reveals high-Chern-number orbital magnetism with Chern number C = n . Electrical and magnetic switching of these states is also demonstrated.

records.title: Shaping the future of quantum technology
records.description: Amal Kasry discusses the shift from quantum science to quantum technology, warning of the risk of a structural divide and emphasizing the need to act now to ensure that these technologies deliver shared prosperity.

records.title: Seamless biointerfaces in devices
records.description: Seamless wet-tissue adhesive bioelectronics, realized by the assembly of strain-insensitive elastomeric electronics and a hydrogel adhesive, allow closed-loop therapeutic modulation.

records.title: Quantum tunnelling and leakage current across two-dimensional materials
records.description: Leakage current affects the operation and reliability of electronic devices, but obtaining accurate measurements of leakage current across two-dimensional (2D) materials has been difficult. This article accurately quantifies the leakage current across hBN, MoS 2 and WS 2 with different thicknesses and compares them with SiO 2 , which helps predict the performance and reliability of 2D materials-based electronic devices.

records.title: An artificial neuromorphic interface for auditory restoration
records.description: Hearing loss affects millions of people, requiring technology to repair their auditory pathway. A biohybrid interface is developed that combines a self-powered acoustic device and an artificial auditory neural circuit, enabling restoration of auditory function in a rabbit model of hearing impairment.

records.title: Intranasal DNA nanocarrier vaccines with surface-patterned antigens enhance efficacy against respiratory syncytial virus
records.description: DNA-based nanocarrier vaccines with optimized surface antigen arrangements induce mucosal, humoral and cellular immunity and are effective intranasal vaccines for diverse respiratory diseases.

records.title: High-precision memristor-based computing
records.description: Understanding inherent properties and coordinated design at the device, array and system levels can help achieve accurate computing with memristors.

records.title: Surface geometry controls bulk topological defects that govern embryonic structures
records.description: Topological defects are of central importance in ordered systems, including living matter, but how they are controlled in three dimensions has been unclear. It is now shown that boundary geometry governs three-dimensional defect configurations that, in developing embryos, determine the sites of lumen formation.

records.title: Boundary geometry controls a topological defect transition that determines lumen nucleation in embryonic development
records.description: The geometry of confining boundaries is shown to control three-dimensional topological defect configurations that precede formation of the central lumen in the developing mouse embryo, a key process in embryogenesis.

records.title: Electron–phonon coupling and symmetry breaking in superconducting oxide interfaces near ferroelectric quantum criticality
records.description: Conductivity and superconductivity at the LaAlO 3 /SrTiO 3 interface are well established. Now, in a layer-by-layer fashion, oxygen octahedra rotations, polar displacements and vibrational modes that are parallel and perpendicular to the interface are probed. A doping-dependent study reveals phonon modes related to oxygen vibrations, and their connection to superconductivity is discussed.

records.title: A highly conductive polar metal with efficient charge–spin conversion
records.description: The energy efficiency of spin-source materials can be increased by combining low resistivity and high charge–spin conversion in a single material. Now, a layered delafossite achieves this combination through polar distortions that break inversion symmetry while preserving high metallic conductivity.

records.title: Lattice distortion activates deformation twinning in ultrastrong steel
records.description: Ultrastrong and ductile martensitic steel is achieved by taking advantage of its severe lattice distortion, which activates twinning as the plasticity carrier in martensite.

records.title: Giant and broadband circular dichroism from particle–hole symmetry breaking in Weyl semimetals
records.description: The different Fermi velocities of particle and hole bands result in a giant mid-infrared circular dichroism in the magnetic Weyl semimetal Mn(Bi 1 − x Sb x ) 2 Te 4 .

records.title: Nanotechnology-mediated precision delivery of mRNA
records.description: Delivery of mRNA to cells and tissues with minimal off-targeting and high efficiencies is a current challenge for mRNA therapeutics. This Review discusses strategies to achieve precision delivery of mRNA and highlights their applications in vaccines and gene therapies.

records.title: Methane storage using metal–dipyrazolate frameworks
records.description: Reversible phase transformations enable flexible metal–bipyrazolate frameworks to offer high deliverable methane capacities, high stability and recyclability, indicating utility in natural gas storage.

records.title: Memristive devices for memory and computing
records.description: Abu Sebastian, a distinguished research scientist at IBM Research in Zurich, talks to Nature Materials about the opportunities and challenges of memristive devices for in-memory computing and their potential to commercialization.

records.title: Author Correction: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
Material considerations of memristors at the nanoscale
records.description: Ilia Valov, a professor at the Institute of Electrochemistry and Energy Systems, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, and at the Forschungszentrum Jülich, talks to Nature Materials about the relationship between nanoscale structure, composition, electrochemistry and the properties and functionalities of memristors.

records.title: Excitonic spin torque in a magnetic semiconductor
records.description: Distinct magnon dynamics are observed at high excitation pump power in the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr, and attributed to an interplay between excitons and magnetization.

records.title: Chain entanglements enable regeneration of high-performance thermosets
records.description: Dense covalent networks enhance mechanical properties in thermoset materials but hinder recyclability. Glassy thermosets with load-bearing capacity driven by chain entanglements are shown, decoupling mechanical performance from crosslink density and enabling reprocessing and regeneration.

records.title: A metabolic boost to mRNA vaccines
records.description: Crosslinked ionizable lipids enable mRNA lipid nanoparticles to metabolically reprogram immune cells to elicit strong vaccine responses while reducing inflammatory side effects.

records.title: Polar nano-regions enable large spin Hall conductivity in metallic PtCoO 2
records.description: A large spin Hall conductivity is reported for the quasi-two-dimensional metallic delafossite PtCoO 2 and attributed to polar lattice distortions that break inversion symmetry.

records.title: Strain-insensitive wet-tissue-adhesive biphasic bioelectronics for physicochemical monitoring and adaptive therapy
records.description: A stretchable, strain-insensitive elastomer–hydrogel bioelectronics platform enables simultaneous physical sensing, chemical monitoring and neuromodulation for closed-loop disease management in diabetic rats.

records.title: Author Correction: Atomically precise photothermal nanomachines
Author Correction: Extreme phonon anharmonicity underpins superionic diffusion and ultralow thermal conductivity in argyrodite Ag8SnSe6
Stretchable high-fill-factor silicon–liquid metal platform for multilevel visual acquisition and depth sensing
records.description: High-density stretchable pixelated electronics are promising for next-generation robotic vision. By integrating single-crystalline silicon pixels with finely patterned liquid metal interconnects on elastomeric substrates, a human-eye-inspired robotic vision system and a skin-mountable lens-free imaging system with multiscale visual acquisition and depth-sensing are realized.

records.title: Ultralow-voltage electrochemical organic light-emitting transistors with pinned and wide lateral recombination
records.description: Organic light-emitting transistors require a large operating voltage and exhibit a narrow recombination zone, owing to inefficient charge injection. By incorporating an ion transport enhancer into light-emitting polymers, organic light-emitting transistors achieving <3.5-V voltage operation and a maximum recombination zone width of ~267 µm are realized.

records.title: Battery minerals for neural inhibition
records.description: Triphylite (LiFePO 4 ), a lithium mineral battery cathode, is incorporated into a bioelectronic device for controlled and localized lithium delivery to neurons, establishing a precision strategy for neural inhibition.

records.title: High impact resistance in a high-entropy alloy with thermally stable hierarchical heterostructures
records.description: Face-centred cubic high-entropy alloys with a core–shell heterostructure, uniformly distributed nanoscale precipitates and oxide nanoparticles in the shell are developed. The hierarchical microstructures are thermally stable up to 1,000 °C and show high impact toughness.

records.title: Tracking microstructure and mechanical response
records.description: Characterizing structural evolution alongside mechanical behaviour is challenging for micro- and nanostructured materials, highlighting the need for advancing in situ characterization techniques.

records.title: In situ mechanical characterization of functional and architected materials
records.description: Recent developments in in situ micro- and nanoscale mechanical characterization, equipped with exceptional spatial and temporal resolution, are expanding frontiers in the study of functional materials, whose properties are largely defined by their nano- and microscale features. This Review presents a comprehensive overview of these characterization methods and highlights their applications in low-dimensional and architected materials.

records.title: Boosting ionic conductivity of single-ion conductive polyelectrolyte elastomers via high-dielectric plasticizers
records.description: Polyelectrolyte elastomers support selective and leakage-free ionic transport, but suffer from low ionic conductivity. A solid-state dielectric additive is introduced to various polyelectrolyte elastomers, which increases ionic conductivity by two orders of magnitude and maintains elasticity and leakage-free properties.

records.title: Magnetoelectric microrobots for spinal cord injury regeneration
records.description: Microrobots made of human-induced pluripotent stem cells and magnetoelectric nanoparticles promote lesion repair and motor improvements after spinal cord injury in zebrafish and mice under magnetic guidance and stimulation.

records.title: Van der Waals strain hardening and large uniform tensile elongation in GaSe
records.description: Substantial strain hardening can be triggered in GaSe and other similar chalcogenide single crystals at particular loading directions inclined to the [0001] zone axis via alternating interlayer slip. This mechanism results in large uniform tensile elongation exceeding 40%, with the ultimate tensile elongation surpassing 70%.

records.title: Fibronectin matrix remodelling modulates the active nematic dynamics of cancer-associated fibroblasts
records.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and fibronectin form a coupled active–passive nematic that progressively freezes, creating a mechanically stable stromal barrier.

records.title: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
records.description: Ultraviolet damage and the thermal instability of self-assembled monolayers hamper the durability of perovskite solar cells. Modifying the spacer units in these monolayers revealed the mechanisms of photodegradation and thermal degradation in non-conjugated and conjugated structures, respectively. Specifically designed spacer molecules can achieve highly efficient and stable perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Fibronectin matrix remodelling modulates the active nematic dynamics of cancer-associated fibroblasts
records.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and fibronectin form a coupled active–passive nematic that progressively freezes, creating a mechanically stable stromal barrier.

records.title: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
records.description: Ultraviolet damage and the thermal instability of self-assembled monolayers hamper the durability of perovskite solar cells. Modifying the spacer units in these monolayers revealed the mechanisms of photodegradation and thermal degradation in non-conjugated and conjugated structures, respectively. Specifically designed spacer molecules can achieve highly efficient and stable perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Cross-material catalyst discovery via deep learning
records.description: A deep-learning framework unites knowledge from distinct catalyst families to predict an unexplored class of water-splitting catalysts, revealing an active single-atom catalyst that outperforms both the training and predicted material classes.

records.title: In-plane anomalous Hall effect in a low-dimensional system
records.description: A gate-tunable magnetization-driven in-plane anomalous Hall effect is realized in a low-symmetry heterostructure of TaIrTe 4 and layered ferromagnetic insulator Cr 2 Ge 2 Te 6 .

records.title: Watching excitons synchronize
records.description: The oscillating electric field emitted by excitons in layered antiferromagnets reveals how quasiparticles synchronize into collective coherence and shows that a complex multi-peak spectrum can arise from a single excitonic resonance dynamically modulated by spin and lattice excitations.

records.title: Tailoring crystal phases of high-entropy alloy catalysts
records.description: Template-directed growth unlocks metastable stacking symmetry and tailorable crystal phases in multicomponent alloys, enabling improved efficiency and long-term stability in proton exchange membrane water electrolysis.

records.title: Delivering base editors to the lungs
records.description: A chemically modular amino acid-based ionizable lipid platform advances intratracheal lipid nanoparticle-mediated delivery of RNA base editors to airway epithelia and corrects genetic mutation in cystic fibrosis.

records.title: Probing the quantum metric of 3D topological insulators
records.description: The quantum metric of a surface Dirac cone is found to contribute to the nonlinear magnetoresistance of thin films of the 3D topological insulator Sb 2 Te 3 .

records.title: Author Correction: Bose–Einstein condensation of a two-magnon bound state in a spin-1 triangular lattice
High-throughput in situ sizing and quantum yield determination of individual perovskite nanocrystals
records.description: Interferometric scattering microscopy combined with photoluminescence imaging enables the fast, high-throughput screening of size and quantum yield for thousands of perovskite nanocubes at the single-particle level across their entire life cycle.

records.title: Layer photovoltaic effect in a two-dimensional antiferromagnet with parity–time symmetry
records.description: A layer-dependent photocurrent is demonstrated in bilayer CrSBr, and it can be directly controlled by the magnetic configuration.

records.title: Energy loop for afterglow imaging
records.description: A month-long afterglow probe that is selectively deactivated by cytochrome P450 enzymes in healthy tissues achieves high tumour-to-liver ratio detection of hepatic tumours in mouse and rabbit models.

records.title: All-optical control of antiferromagnetic domains via an inverse optical magnetoelectric effect
records.description: All-optical writing of antiferromagnetic domains using the inverse optical magnetoelectric effect in ferrotoroidic LiNiPO 4 is demonstrated.

records.title: Crystal-phase memory in metastable AlScN
records.description: Electric-field-driven switching between competing crystal structures in AlScN points to a non-volatile memory concept with remarkable stability at elevated temperatures.

records.title: A Sc 2 C 2 @C 88 -cluster-based ultra-compact multilevel probabilistic bit for matrix multiplication
records.description: Electric-field-controllable, stochastic alteration of multiple conductance states in a Sc 2 C 2 @C 88 cluster is observed. A matrix-chain multiplication of two 4 × 4 state-transition matrices is demonstrated using this cluster with maximum error of less than 0.05.

records.title: Detecting linear dichroism with atomic resolution
records.description: An electron linear dichroism method uses electron energy loss spectroscopy with an atomic-sized probe and momentum transfer selection along two orthogonal directions to resolve orbital occupation at individual atomic columns in real space.

records.title: Strategies of high-accuracy memristor-based analogue computing in memory for artificial intelligence
records.description: Noise and non-ideal characteristics at the device and circuit levels lead to errors in memristor-based analogue computing. This Review dissects the computing error sources from memristor-based device, array and system levels, evaluates strategies to minimize errors, and draws a roadmap for large-scale deployment to accelerate AI applications.

records.title: Two-dimensional magnets stack up against multiferroic competition
records.description: Bilayer 1T-CrTe 2 breaks time-reversal and inversion symmetry in its magnetic state, allowing for strong magnetoelectric coupling at room temperature.

records.title: Guiding sulfur without crystallizing it
records.description: Real-time operando scattering and spectroscopy uncover how controlled disorder in sulfurized polyacrylonitrile stabilizes short sulfur chains, suppresses polysulfide loss and enables highly reversible lithium–sulfur batteries.

records.title: Observing energy materials in action
records.description: Operando measurements of energy materials can resolve complex electrochemical processes, leading to in-depth mechanistic insight.

records.title: Field-resolved observation of exciton coherence in a van der Waals magnet
records.description: Coherent exciton dynamics in antiferromagnetic CrSBr are studied by petahertz field-resolved spectroscopy, revealing how laser-imprinted exciton coherence persists beyond excitation and is modulated by spin and lattice modes.

records.title: Fibrillar adhesion dynamics govern the timescales of nuclear mechano-response via the vimentin cytoskeleton
records.description: Nuclear deformation and mechano-signalling are regulated by the coupling of vimentin cytoskeleton to the extracellular matrix through fibrillar adhesions, modulating the timescale of mechanotransduction on force removal.

records.title: Narrow-bandgap acceptors with low energetic disorder achieve over 21% efficiency in organic solar cells
records.description: Narrow-bandgap acceptors with minimal energy loss and high short-circuit current density for organic solar cells are rare. Here a designed acceptor incorporated into ternary blends achieves low energy loss of 0.486 eV and high short-circuit current density of 28.82 mA cm −2 , resulting in a 21.12% certified efficiency in organic solar cells.

records.title: Ion correlations explain kinetic selectivity in diffusion-limited solid-state synthesis reactions
records.description: Cross-ion correlations are crucial to quantitatively explain the appearance of intermediate phases and final product fractions during powder synthesis.

records.title: Optical nanoscopy of spatiotemporal metal stripping cooperativity at single-ion and subparticle resolution
records.description: Complex coupled ion–electron interfacial processes are poorly understood but crucial to battery dynamics. Here an ion-localization optical nanoscopy that enables single-ion imaging at 50 nm spatial and 20-ms temporal resolution at the single-particle level is presented and used to observe metal stripping cooperativity on Zn anodes.

records.title: Author Correction: Magnon confinement in epitaxial antiferromagnetic oxide heterostructures
To bioprint morphogenic organoids it is essential to chill out and relax
records.description: High-throughput and controlled organoid fabrication is achieved by combining 3D bioprinting, matrix biochemistry and stress relaxation in packed hydrogel particles.

records.title: Sub-wavelength extreme ultraviolet microscopy reveals domain-wall stability during ultrafast demagnetization
records.description: Femtosecond extreme ultraviolet microscopy is used to directly image domain-wall dynamics during laser-induced demagnetization. The domain walls are found to be stable up to the onset of irreversible magnetic switching.

records.title: The data-only illusion in materials discovery
records.description: Artificial intelligence may have transformed image and language generation, but in materials science, data scarcity and synthesis complexity demand a different approach. Only by coupling artificial intelligence with deep chemical insight can we turn virtual predictions into real materials.

records.title: Contact-reaction-triggered selective doping
records.description: A gold-surface-mediated doping strategy offers a solution to achieve spatially resolved chemical doping in organic semiconductors, enabling facile control for high-performance organic devices.

records.title: Two-dimensional hard masks push three-dimensional patterning
records.description: Ultrathin van der Waals metal oxyhalides act as robust hard masks for three-dimensional semiconductor processing. Their exceptional plasma resistance and unique plasma-induced smoothing enable high-aspect-ratio etching and precise nanopatterning of various materials.

records.title: A nitride-based non-volatile memory enabled by electric-field-induced phase transition
records.description: A non-volatile Al 0.7 Sc 0.3 N-based memory is developed with low switching voltage, fast write speed, low energy consumption and ~10 8 -cycle write endurance at 583 K, with excellent stability and uniformity.

records.title: Observation of strong tripartite coupling in a cavity-quantum circuit-antiferromagnet platform
records.description: Hybridized modes are realized through strong tripartite coupling between a three-dimensional microwave cavity, a granular-aluminium superconducting thin-film microwave resonator circuit and an antiferromagnetic crystal, with implications for sensing and for frequency conversion between the microwave and terahertz regimes.

records.title: Anisotropic lattice distortion makes ultrastrong martensitic steel ductile
records.description: The brittleness of as-quenched carbon martensitic steel is overcome by introducing severe lattice distortion through the addition of high concentrations of substitutional solutes and carbon. This lattice distortion transforms the traditionally detrimental crystallographic anisotropy of martensite into an effective contributor to ductility.

records.title: Condensate corona–nanoparticle complexes transfer functional biomolecules between cells
records.description: After being internalized by cells, nanoparticles can, in rare events, acquire a biomolecular condensate corona. These complexes can reach the extracellular space, where they can deliver their acquired proteins and RNA content to other cells.

records.title: Turning excitons to the dark side
records.description: Hubbard excitons capture the many-body correlations of Mott insulators. Using ultrafast light, their quantum wavefunction can be coherently rotated, opening a path towards optical quantum control and sensing in strongly correlated materials.

records.title: Rapid sintering of ultrafine-grained refractory metals under mild conditions
records.description: The introduction of liquid metals to refractory metals weakens metal bonding, which enables rapid, low-temperature fabrication of refractory metal bulk materials with ultrafine grains, high strength and tunable composition.

records.title: Minimally invasive bioelectronic implants
records.description: Minimally invasive medical procedures are widely used in clinical practice. This Review discusses recent advances in bioelectronic devices that can be implanted using minimally invasive technologies, highlighting innovations in the materials and design to engineer personalized bioelectronic systems.

records.title: Efficient and reversible chirality induction between protein and achiral plasmonic assemblies
records.description: Mechanical modulation of protein conformation enables the reversible induction of strong plasmon-coupled circular dichroism in otherwise achiral plasmonic assemblies.

records.title: An ultrasound-scanning in vivo light source
records.description: A deep-tissue light source made from mechanoluminescent transducers stimulated by focused ultrasound enables wide imaging of live animal vasculature, and modulation of neuronal activity and behaviour.

records.title: Efficient and reversible chirality induction between protein and achiral plasmonic assemblies
records.description: Mechanical modulation of protein conformation enables the reversible induction of strong plasmon-coupled circular dichroism in otherwise achiral plasmonic assemblies.

records.title: An ultrasound-scanning in vivo light source
records.description: A deep-tissue light source made from mechanoluminescent transducers stimulated by focused ultrasound enables wide imaging of live animal vasculature, and modulation of neuronal activity and behaviour.

records.title: Orbital-hybridization-induced Ising-type superconductivity in a confined gallium layer
records.description: Orbital hybridization and quantum confinement are used to realize Ising-like superconductivity in trilayers of gallium, which alone is probably not strongly enough spin–orbit coupled to host such superconductivity under high in-plane magnetic fields.

records.title: All-van der Waals microcavities for low-loss nonlinear photonics
records.description: Photonic components fabricated from van der Waals materials and patterned using focused ion beam lithography with aluminium passivation demonstrate quality factors exceeding 10 6 and an efficient nonlinear optical response.

records.title: Two-dimensional materials for integrated sensing
records.description: Two-dimensional (2D) materials are promising for in situ encoding and optoelectronic sensing in computing technologies. This Review discusses integrated optoelectronic sensing based on 2D materials and future challenges and prospects for integrated sensing encoding information beyond optical signals.

records.title: Bulk nano-heterointerface secures molecular contacts in perovskite solar cells
records.description: The weak contact between the oxide electrode and molecular layer in inverted perovskite solar cells is prone to deformation, limiting long-term device stability. A bulk nano-heterointerface is designed to strengthen the binding force between molecules and spherical silicon oxide nanoparticles, increasing the interfacial contact area and improving the operational stability of perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Hydrogels find their inner magnetism
records.description: Hydrogels containing C=O groups and calcium cations show an unexpected paramagnetic effect that may have biomedical applications.

records.title: Nanophotonic chip-space interfaces for multidimensional nonlinear optics
records.description: Reconfigurable chip-to-free-space interfaces based on thin-film lithium niobate microrings generate on-demand nonlinear structured light, including tunable optical vortices, optical skyrmions and spatiotemporal vortex pulses.

records.title: Static magnetization switching in an artificial antiferromagnetic multilayer driven by a voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy effect
records.description: For conventional voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) switching, a small variation in the pulse widths of the order of several picoseconds can cause switching failure. Now, VCMA-driven static magnetization switching is demonstrated, which is largely insensitive to pulse widths within certain thresholds.

records.title: Removing aluminium impurities in primary magnesium at an ultra-low cost
records.description: Introducing cost-effective CaO removes aluminium impurities in magnesium vapour with over 90% efficiency, enabling the affordable, large-scale production of high-purity magnesium with low aluminium.

records.title: Option for transparent peer review
records.description: Authors whose research paper is accepted for publication at Nature Materials now have the option to include the reviewers’ comments and their rebuttal letters with their publication.

records.title: Tuning phonon transmission via single-atom substituents
records.description: Atomic-level changes to molecular junctions are found to tune the thermal conductance of the junctions by a factor of two. These observations, performed using high-resolution calorimetric scanning tunnelling probes, show how single atoms can influence and control phonon transport in molecular junctions.

records.title: Magnetic drag from frustrated order
records.description: Friction typically scales with load but magnetic systems can defy this rule. Sliding arrays of magnetic rotors reveal that energy dissipation peaks where competing magnetic orders dynamically clash. This non-monotonic magnetic drag arises from sliding-induced hysteresis, offering a blueprint for tunable, contactless braking at any scale.

records.title: Amino acid-derived ionizable lipids enable inhaled base editing for therapeutic gene correction in the lung
records.description: Gene correction in the lung is achieved with inhalable mRNA lipid nanoparticles containing an amino acid-derived ionizable lipid identified from screening and structure–function optimization studies.

records.title: Synthesis of 4H-phase high-entropy alloys for electrocatalysis
records.description: Au nanowires with an unconventional hexagonal close-packed (4H) phase stabilize the 4H-phase high-entropy alloys grown epitaxially on their surface through a facile chemical synthesis. The resulting core–shell nanostructures demonstrate promising overall water electrolysis performance.

records.title: Connecting the dots for cooperative emission
records.description: Both superfluorescence and amplified spontaneous emission are observed in giant perovskite nanocrystals with the transition between these two cooperative emission regimes worked out by tuning temperature, excitation fluence and emitter density.

records.title: Transition between cooperative emission regimes in giant perovskite nanocrystals
