The high temperature promotes vacancy-mediated hydrogen trapping and chemical reactions at the carbide–matrix interface, resulting in pronounced embrittlement.

records.title: Van der Waals surface reconstruction for oriented epitaxial growth of two-dimensional metallic oxides
records.description: Large-scale growth of various two-dimensional metallic oxides with high crystalline quality is achieved via mica surface-reconstruction-assisted van der Waals epitaxy, enabling their exploration in quantum physics and spintronic applications.

records.title: Entanglements enable circular engineering plastics
records.description: An entanglement-dominated design strategy combines dense physical chain entanglements with sparse trigger-cleavable covalent crosslinks. This strategy enables high-performance thermosets with generation-invariant regeneration, opening an avenue for circular engineering plastics.

records.title: Jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions as 3D-printable biological tissue mimics
records.description: The scalable formation of jammed interconnected bilayer emulsions provides a platform for replicating structural and functional properties of biological tissues.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Quantum control of Hubbard excitons
One-step etch and peel
Liquid metal and silicon unite
records.description: Interfacing liquid metal with silicon nanomembranes is realized by using a titanium barrier to prevent gallium from leaching out of the eutectic gallium indium liquid metal, achieving visual acquisition and depth sensing with a liquid-metal-based circuit array.

records.title: Two parallel phosphorus economies
records.description: Paul Westerhoff and Jacob Jones discuss how the unique chemistry of phosphorus enables technologies beyond agricultural fertilizers, ranging from batteries to semiconductors and quantum materials.

records.title: Topological piezoelectricity in bulk ferroelectrics
records.description: The piezoelectric response of Pb(Mg 1 /3 Nb 2/3 )O 3 –PbTiO 3 crystals is enhanced through engineering of the vortex domain density.

records.title: Author Correction: Plasmonic printing of high-performance metal oxide electronics under room temperature
Author Correction: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
Unconventional skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets
records.description: Skyrmions with opposite core polarity are found to form in a single sublattice of a compensated synthetic antiferromagnet, offering a route to programmable, layer-selective three-dimensional spin textures.

records.title: Shining light in deep tissue
records.description: Mechanoluminescent nanomaterials administered in the bloodstream enable ultrasound-controlled light emission and deep-tissue optogenetic stimulation of neurons.

records.title: Mechanical regulation of immunity in metastasis
records.description: Mechanical cues regulate both metastatic dissemination and antitumour immunity. Integrating these processes through mechano-immunology may provide a framework to understand metastatic progression.

records.title: In situ scattering optical microscopy offers power in numbers with single-particle precision
records.description: An in situ microscopy technique monitors the size and luminescent properties of thousands of individual nanocrystals within minutes, uncovering size-dependent phenomena in the life cycle of semiconductor nanocrystals.

records.title: Fluoride ions as charge carriers in electrochemical energy storage
records.description: Lithium-ion batteries are commonplace, but large-scale production leads to potential materials criticality constraints. This Review discusses fluoride-anion systems as a potential alternative, outlining design principles for electrodes, materials design concepts, degradation mechanisms and research fronts that must be considered.

records.title: Design principles for π -conjugated hydrogel semiconductors
records.description: The semiconducting behaviour in hydrogels enables advanced electronic applications for biosystems. This Review provides key principles of the design, fabrication, characterizations and benchmarking for π -conjugated hydrogel semiconductors.

records.title: Author Correction: Mechanisms of active wetting and fluidification in epithelial cell collectives
Wafer-scale growth of highly stable p-type semiconducting monolayer MoSi 2 N 4 single crystals
records.description: Wafer-scale monolayer single crystals of p-type semiconducting MoSi 2 N 4 are grown via chemical vapour deposition, and exhibit high mobility and stability.

records.title: Switching from insertion to conversion for multielectron aqueous vanadium batteries
records.description: Conventional aqueous vanadium-ion batteries have low capacities, as the fundamental charge-storage mechanism is a one-electron insertion process. Here, using a mesoporous carbon shell approach, a four-electron conversion reaction for charge storage is demonstrated.

records.title: Twist-angle-controlled anomalous gating in bilayer graphene/BN heterostructures
records.description: Rotational misalignment between the top and bottom boron nitride layers encapsulating graphene acts as a switch for anomalous gating effects, such as gate ineffectiveness and hysteresis. These effects are observed at room temperature within an angle range of 15–45° and are highly sensitive to small angular changes.

records.title: Engineered living materials need engineered EU regulation
records.description: Kai Purnhagen and Justus Wesseler discuss how EU law needs reform to address market access bottlenecks for living composites.

records.title: Multimodal scanning-probe quantum sensing of quantum materials
records.description: Solid-state spin defects are a powerful and versatile class of quantum sensor. This Review covers the development of scanning-probe nitrogen-vacancy sensing as a tool for investigating quantum materials with nanoscale resolution, surveys the recent development of spin defects in 1D and 2D host materials and identifies key directions for future research.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Ultralow-voltage electrochemical organic light-emitting transistors with pinned and wide lateral recombination
Excitons in van der Waals magnetic materials
records.description: In this Review, the interplay of excitons, magnons and photons in two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors and how this enables control of light–matter interactions are discussed, and promising opportunities for magneto-optic optoelectronic and quantum applications are surveyed.

records.title: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
records.description: Triazolate metal–organic frameworks with Zn 5 Cl 4 nodes are formed with terminal Zn-bound groups pointing inwards, creating tunable confined pores. Post-synthetic chloride-to-hydroxide exchange yields dense Zn–OH sites, enabling reversible CO 2 chemisorption and low-pressure CO 2 capture.

records.title: Excitons in van der Waals magnetic materials
records.description: In this Review, the interplay of excitons, magnons and photons in two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors and how this enables control of light–matter interactions are discussed, and promising opportunities for magneto-optic optoelectronic and quantum applications are surveyed.

records.title: Programming local confinements in crystalline frameworks through reticular chemistry
records.description: Triazolate metal–organic frameworks with Zn 5 Cl 4 nodes are formed with terminal Zn-bound groups pointing inwards, creating tunable confined pores. Post-synthetic chloride-to-hydroxide exchange yields dense Zn–OH sites, enabling reversible CO 2 chemisorption and low-pressure CO 2 capture.

records.title: Fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect in moiré fractional Chern insulators
records.description: The fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect serves as the defining experimental manifestation of fractional Chern insulators at zero magnetic field. This Perspective surveys its realization in moiré materials, examines underlying mechanisms and outlines pathways towards new fractional and non-Abelian topological states.

records.title: Single-crystal-like polymer semiconductors via self-templated gradient assembly for ultrahigh charge carrier mobility
records.description: High-performance polymer semiconductors are required for next-generation organic electronics. A strategy that modulates multi-scale structural ordering and controls the alignment of polymers yields single-crystal-like semiconducting polymers with notably improved charge mobility.

records.title: High-Chern-number orbital magnetism in twisted rhombohedral graphene
records.description: Magnetotransport measurements and mean-field calculations of twisted monolayer–multilayer (1 + n ) rhombohedral graphene reveals high-Chern-number orbital magnetism with Chern number C = n . Electrical and magnetic switching of these states is also demonstrated.

records.title: Shaping the future of quantum technology
records.description: Amal Kasry discusses the shift from quantum science to quantum technology, warning of the risk of a structural divide and emphasizing the need to act now to ensure that these technologies deliver shared prosperity.

records.title: Seamless biointerfaces in devices
records.description: Seamless wet-tissue adhesive bioelectronics, realized by the assembly of strain-insensitive elastomeric electronics and a hydrogel adhesive, allow closed-loop therapeutic modulation.

records.title: Quantum tunnelling and leakage current across two-dimensional materials
records.description: Leakage current affects the operation and reliability of electronic devices, but obtaining accurate measurements of leakage current across two-dimensional (2D) materials has been difficult. This article accurately quantifies the leakage current across hBN, MoS 2 and WS 2 with different thicknesses and compares them with SiO 2 , which helps predict the performance and reliability of 2D materials-based electronic devices.

records.title: An artificial neuromorphic interface for auditory restoration
records.description: Hearing loss affects millions of people, requiring technology to repair their auditory pathway. A biohybrid interface is developed that combines a self-powered acoustic device and an artificial auditory neural circuit, enabling restoration of auditory function in a rabbit model of hearing impairment.

records.title: Intranasal DNA nanocarrier vaccines with surface-patterned antigens enhance efficacy against respiratory syncytial virus
records.description: DNA-based nanocarrier vaccines with optimized surface antigen arrangements induce mucosal, humoral and cellular immunity and are effective intranasal vaccines for diverse respiratory diseases.

records.title: High-precision memristor-based computing
records.description: Understanding inherent properties and coordinated design at the device, array and system levels can help achieve accurate computing with memristors.

records.title: Surface geometry controls bulk topological defects that govern embryonic structures
records.description: Topological defects are of central importance in ordered systems, including living matter, but how they are controlled in three dimensions has been unclear. It is now shown that boundary geometry governs three-dimensional defect configurations that, in developing embryos, determine the sites of lumen formation.

records.title: Boundary geometry controls a topological defect transition that determines lumen nucleation in embryonic development
records.description: The geometry of confining boundaries is shown to control three-dimensional topological defect configurations that precede formation of the central lumen in the developing mouse embryo, a key process in embryogenesis.

records.title: Electron–phonon coupling and symmetry breaking in superconducting oxide interfaces near ferroelectric quantum criticality
records.description: Conductivity and superconductivity at the LaAlO 3 /SrTiO 3 interface are well established. Now, in a layer-by-layer fashion, oxygen octahedra rotations, polar displacements and vibrational modes that are parallel and perpendicular to the interface are probed. A doping-dependent study reveals phonon modes related to oxygen vibrations, and their connection to superconductivity is discussed.

records.title: A highly conductive polar metal with efficient charge–spin conversion
records.description: The energy efficiency of spin-source materials can be increased by combining low resistivity and high charge–spin conversion in a single material. Now, a layered delafossite achieves this combination through polar distortions that break inversion symmetry while preserving high metallic conductivity.

records.title: Lattice distortion activates deformation twinning in ultrastrong steel
records.description: Ultrastrong and ductile martensitic steel is achieved by taking advantage of its severe lattice distortion, which activates twinning as the plasticity carrier in martensite.

records.title: Giant and broadband circular dichroism from particle–hole symmetry breaking in Weyl semimetals
records.description: The different Fermi velocities of particle and hole bands result in a giant mid-infrared circular dichroism in the magnetic Weyl semimetal Mn(Bi 1 − x Sb x ) 2 Te 4 .

records.title: Nanotechnology-mediated precision delivery of mRNA
records.description: Delivery of mRNA to cells and tissues with minimal off-targeting and high efficiencies is a current challenge for mRNA therapeutics. This Review discusses strategies to achieve precision delivery of mRNA and highlights their applications in vaccines and gene therapies.

records.title: Methane storage using metal–dipyrazolate frameworks
records.description: Reversible phase transformations enable flexible metal–bipyrazolate frameworks to offer high deliverable methane capacities, high stability and recyclability, indicating utility in natural gas storage.

records.title: Memristive devices for memory and computing
records.description: Abu Sebastian, a distinguished research scientist at IBM Research in Zurich, talks to Nature Materials about the opportunities and challenges of memristive devices for in-memory computing and their potential to commercialization.

records.title: Author Correction: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
Material considerations of memristors at the nanoscale
records.description: Ilia Valov, a professor at the Institute of Electrochemistry and Energy Systems, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, and at the Forschungszentrum Jülich, talks to Nature Materials about the relationship between nanoscale structure, composition, electrochemistry and the properties and functionalities of memristors.

records.title: Excitonic spin torque in a magnetic semiconductor
records.description: Distinct magnon dynamics are observed at high excitation pump power in the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrSBr, and attributed to an interplay between excitons and magnetization.

records.title: Chain entanglements enable regeneration of high-performance thermosets
records.description: Dense covalent networks enhance mechanical properties in thermoset materials but hinder recyclability. Glassy thermosets with load-bearing capacity driven by chain entanglements are shown, decoupling mechanical performance from crosslink density and enabling reprocessing and regeneration.

records.title: A metabolic boost to mRNA vaccines
records.description: Crosslinked ionizable lipids enable mRNA lipid nanoparticles to metabolically reprogram immune cells to elicit strong vaccine responses while reducing inflammatory side effects.

records.title: Polar nano-regions enable large spin Hall conductivity in metallic PtCoO 2
records.description: A large spin Hall conductivity is reported for the quasi-two-dimensional metallic delafossite PtCoO 2 and attributed to polar lattice distortions that break inversion symmetry.

records.title: Strain-insensitive wet-tissue-adhesive biphasic bioelectronics for physicochemical monitoring and adaptive therapy
records.description: A stretchable, strain-insensitive elastomer–hydrogel bioelectronics platform enables simultaneous physical sensing, chemical monitoring and neuromodulation for closed-loop disease management in diabetic rats.

records.title: Author Correction: Atomically precise photothermal nanomachines
Author Correction: Extreme phonon anharmonicity underpins superionic diffusion and ultralow thermal conductivity in argyrodite Ag8SnSe6
Stretchable high-fill-factor silicon–liquid metal platform for multilevel visual acquisition and depth sensing
records.description: High-density stretchable pixelated electronics are promising for next-generation robotic vision. By integrating single-crystalline silicon pixels with finely patterned liquid metal interconnects on elastomeric substrates, a human-eye-inspired robotic vision system and a skin-mountable lens-free imaging system with multiscale visual acquisition and depth-sensing are realized.

records.title: Ultralow-voltage electrochemical organic light-emitting transistors with pinned and wide lateral recombination
records.description: Organic light-emitting transistors require a large operating voltage and exhibit a narrow recombination zone, owing to inefficient charge injection. By incorporating an ion transport enhancer into light-emitting polymers, organic light-emitting transistors achieving <3.5-V voltage operation and a maximum recombination zone width of ~267 µm are realized.

records.title: Battery minerals for neural inhibition
records.description: Triphylite (LiFePO 4 ), a lithium mineral battery cathode, is incorporated into a bioelectronic device for controlled and localized lithium delivery to neurons, establishing a precision strategy for neural inhibition.

records.title: High impact resistance in a high-entropy alloy with thermally stable hierarchical heterostructures
records.description: Face-centred cubic high-entropy alloys with a core–shell heterostructure, uniformly distributed nanoscale precipitates and oxide nanoparticles in the shell are developed. The hierarchical microstructures are thermally stable up to 1,000 °C and show high impact toughness.

records.title: Tracking microstructure and mechanical response
records.description: Characterizing structural evolution alongside mechanical behaviour is challenging for micro- and nanostructured materials, highlighting the need for advancing in situ characterization techniques.

records.title: In situ mechanical characterization of functional and architected materials
records.description: Recent developments in in situ micro- and nanoscale mechanical characterization, equipped with exceptional spatial and temporal resolution, are expanding frontiers in the study of functional materials, whose properties are largely defined by their nano- and microscale features. This Review presents a comprehensive overview of these characterization methods and highlights their applications in low-dimensional and architected materials.

records.title: Boosting ionic conductivity of single-ion conductive polyelectrolyte elastomers via high-dielectric plasticizers
records.description: Polyelectrolyte elastomers support selective and leakage-free ionic transport, but suffer from low ionic conductivity. A solid-state dielectric additive is introduced to various polyelectrolyte elastomers, which increases ionic conductivity by two orders of magnitude and maintains elasticity and leakage-free properties.

records.title: Magnetoelectric microrobots for spinal cord injury regeneration
records.description: Microrobots made of human-induced pluripotent stem cells and magnetoelectric nanoparticles promote lesion repair and motor improvements after spinal cord injury in zebrafish and mice under magnetic guidance and stimulation.

records.title: Van der Waals strain hardening and large uniform tensile elongation in GaSe
records.description: Substantial strain hardening can be triggered in GaSe and other similar chalcogenide single crystals at particular loading directions inclined to the [0001] zone axis via alternating interlayer slip. This mechanism results in large uniform tensile elongation exceeding 40%, with the ultimate tensile elongation surpassing 70%.

records.title: Fibronectin matrix remodelling modulates the active nematic dynamics of cancer-associated fibroblasts
records.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and fibronectin form a coupled active–passive nematic that progressively freezes, creating a mechanically stable stromal barrier.

records.title: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
records.description: Ultraviolet damage and the thermal instability of self-assembled monolayers hamper the durability of perovskite solar cells. Modifying the spacer units in these monolayers revealed the mechanisms of photodegradation and thermal degradation in non-conjugated and conjugated structures, respectively. Specifically designed spacer molecules can achieve highly efficient and stable perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Fibronectin matrix remodelling modulates the active nematic dynamics of cancer-associated fibroblasts
records.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and fibronectin form a coupled active–passive nematic that progressively freezes, creating a mechanically stable stromal barrier.

records.title: UV and thermally stable hole-selective contacts with enhanced assembly density for inverted perovskite solar cells
records.description: Ultraviolet damage and the thermal instability of self-assembled monolayers hamper the durability of perovskite solar cells. Modifying the spacer units in these monolayers revealed the mechanisms of photodegradation and thermal degradation in non-conjugated and conjugated structures, respectively. Specifically designed spacer molecules can achieve highly efficient and stable perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Cross-material catalyst discovery via deep learning
records.description: A deep-learning framework unites knowledge from distinct catalyst families to predict an unexplored class of water-splitting catalysts, revealing an active single-atom catalyst that outperforms both the training and predicted material classes.

records.title: In-plane anomalous Hall effect in a low-dimensional system
records.description: A gate-tunable magnetization-driven in-plane anomalous Hall effect is realized in a low-symmetry heterostructure of TaIrTe 4 and layered ferromagnetic insulator Cr 2 Ge 2 Te 6 .

records.title: Watching excitons synchronize
records.description: The oscillating electric field emitted by excitons in layered antiferromagnets reveals how quasiparticles synchronize into collective coherence and shows that a complex multi-peak spectrum can arise from a single excitonic resonance dynamically modulated by spin and lattice excitations.

records.title: Tailoring crystal phases of high-entropy alloy catalysts
records.description: Template-directed growth unlocks metastable stacking symmetry and tailorable crystal phases in multicomponent alloys, enabling improved efficiency and long-term stability in proton exchange membrane water electrolysis.

records.title: Delivering base editors to the lungs
records.description: A chemically modular amino acid-based ionizable lipid platform advances intratracheal lipid nanoparticle-mediated delivery of RNA base editors to airway epithelia and corrects genetic mutation in cystic fibrosis.

records.title: Probing the quantum metric of 3D topological insulators
records.description: The quantum metric of a surface Dirac cone is found to contribute to the nonlinear magnetoresistance of thin films of the 3D topological insulator Sb 2 Te 3 .

records.title: Author Correction: Bose–Einstein condensation of a two-magnon bound state in a spin-1 triangular lattice
High-throughput in situ sizing and quantum yield determination of individual perovskite nanocrystals
records.description: Interferometric scattering microscopy combined with photoluminescence imaging enables the fast, high-throughput screening of size and quantum yield for thousands of perovskite nanocubes at the single-particle level across their entire life cycle.

records.title: Layer photovoltaic effect in a two-dimensional antiferromagnet with parity–time symmetry
records.description: A layer-dependent photocurrent is demonstrated in bilayer CrSBr, and it can be directly controlled by the magnetic configuration.

records.title: Energy loop for afterglow imaging
records.description: A month-long afterglow probe that is selectively deactivated by cytochrome P450 enzymes in healthy tissues achieves high tumour-to-liver ratio detection of hepatic tumours in mouse and rabbit models.

records.title: All-optical control of antiferromagnetic domains via an inverse optical magnetoelectric effect
records.description: All-optical writing of antiferromagnetic domains using the inverse optical magnetoelectric effect in ferrotoroidic LiNiPO 4 is demonstrated.

records.title: Crystal-phase memory in metastable AlScN
records.description: Electric-field-driven switching between competing crystal structures in AlScN points to a non-volatile memory concept with remarkable stability at elevated temperatures.

records.title: A Sc 2 C 2 @C 88 -cluster-based ultra-compact multilevel probabilistic bit for matrix multiplication
records.description: Electric-field-controllable, stochastic alteration of multiple conductance states in a Sc 2 C 2 @C 88 cluster is observed. A matrix-chain multiplication of two 4 × 4 state-transition matrices is demonstrated using this cluster with maximum error of less than 0.05.

records.title: Detecting linear dichroism with atomic resolution
records.description: An electron linear dichroism method uses electron energy loss spectroscopy with an atomic-sized probe and momentum transfer selection along two orthogonal directions to resolve orbital occupation at individual atomic columns in real space.

records.title: Strategies of high-accuracy memristor-based analogue computing in memory for artificial intelligence
records.description: Noise and non-ideal characteristics at the device and circuit levels lead to errors in memristor-based analogue computing. This Review dissects the computing error sources from memristor-based device, array and system levels, evaluates strategies to minimize errors, and draws a roadmap for large-scale deployment to accelerate AI applications.

records.title: Two-dimensional magnets stack up against multiferroic competition
records.description: Bilayer 1T-CrTe 2 breaks time-reversal and inversion symmetry in its magnetic state, allowing for strong magnetoelectric coupling at room temperature.

records.title: Guiding sulfur without crystallizing it
records.description: Real-time operando scattering and spectroscopy uncover how controlled disorder in sulfurized polyacrylonitrile stabilizes short sulfur chains, suppresses polysulfide loss and enables highly reversible lithium–sulfur batteries.

records.title: Observing energy materials in action
records.description: Operando measurements of energy materials can resolve complex electrochemical processes, leading to in-depth mechanistic insight.

records.title: Field-resolved observation of exciton coherence in a van der Waals magnet
records.description: Coherent exciton dynamics in antiferromagnetic CrSBr are studied by petahertz field-resolved spectroscopy, revealing how laser-imprinted exciton coherence persists beyond excitation and is modulated by spin and lattice modes.

records.title: Fibrillar adhesion dynamics govern the timescales of nuclear mechano-response via the vimentin cytoskeleton
records.description: Nuclear deformation and mechano-signalling are regulated by the coupling of vimentin cytoskeleton to the extracellular matrix through fibrillar adhesions, modulating the timescale of mechanotransduction on force removal.

records.title: Narrow-bandgap acceptors with low energetic disorder achieve over 21% efficiency in organic solar cells
records.description: Narrow-bandgap acceptors with minimal energy loss and high short-circuit current density for organic solar cells are rare. Here a designed acceptor incorporated into ternary blends achieves low energy loss of 0.486 eV and high short-circuit current density of 28.82 mA cm −2 , resulting in a 21.12% certified efficiency in organic solar cells.

records.title: Ion correlations explain kinetic selectivity in diffusion-limited solid-state synthesis reactions
records.description: Cross-ion correlations are crucial to quantitatively explain the appearance of intermediate phases and final product fractions during powder synthesis.

records.title: Optical nanoscopy of spatiotemporal metal stripping cooperativity at single-ion and subparticle resolution
records.description: Complex coupled ion–electron interfacial processes are poorly understood but crucial to battery dynamics. Here an ion-localization optical nanoscopy that enables single-ion imaging at 50 nm spatial and 20-ms temporal resolution at the single-particle level is presented and used to observe metal stripping cooperativity on Zn anodes.

records.title: Author Correction: Magnon confinement in epitaxial antiferromagnetic oxide heterostructures
To bioprint morphogenic organoids it is essential to chill out and relax
records.description: High-throughput and controlled organoid fabrication is achieved by combining 3D bioprinting, matrix biochemistry and stress relaxation in packed hydrogel particles.

records.title: Sub-wavelength extreme ultraviolet microscopy reveals domain-wall stability during ultrafast demagnetization
records.description: Femtosecond extreme ultraviolet microscopy is used to directly image domain-wall dynamics during laser-induced demagnetization. The domain walls are found to be stable up to the onset of irreversible magnetic switching.

records.title: The data-only illusion in materials discovery
records.description: Artificial intelligence may have transformed image and language generation, but in materials science, data scarcity and synthesis complexity demand a different approach. Only by coupling artificial intelligence with deep chemical insight can we turn virtual predictions into real materials.

records.title: Contact-reaction-triggered selective doping
records.description: A gold-surface-mediated doping strategy offers a solution to achieve spatially resolved chemical doping in organic semiconductors, enabling facile control for high-performance organic devices.

records.title: Two-dimensional hard masks push three-dimensional patterning
records.description: Ultrathin van der Waals metal oxyhalides act as robust hard masks for three-dimensional semiconductor processing. Their exceptional plasma resistance and unique plasma-induced smoothing enable high-aspect-ratio etching and precise nanopatterning of various materials.

records.title: A nitride-based non-volatile memory enabled by electric-field-induced phase transition
records.description: A non-volatile Al 0.7 Sc 0.3 N-based memory is developed with low switching voltage, fast write speed, low energy consumption and ~10 8 -cycle write endurance at 583 K, with excellent stability and uniformity.

records.title: Observation of strong tripartite coupling in a cavity-quantum circuit-antiferromagnet platform
records.description: Hybridized modes are realized through strong tripartite coupling between a three-dimensional microwave cavity, a granular-aluminium superconducting thin-film microwave resonator circuit and an antiferromagnetic crystal, with implications for sensing and for frequency conversion between the microwave and terahertz regimes.

records.title: Anisotropic lattice distortion makes ultrastrong martensitic steel ductile
records.description: The brittleness of as-quenched carbon martensitic steel is overcome by introducing severe lattice distortion through the addition of high concentrations of substitutional solutes and carbon. This lattice distortion transforms the traditionally detrimental crystallographic anisotropy of martensite into an effective contributor to ductility.

records.title: Condensate corona–nanoparticle complexes transfer functional biomolecules between cells
records.description: After being internalized by cells, nanoparticles can, in rare events, acquire a biomolecular condensate corona. These complexes can reach the extracellular space, where they can deliver their acquired proteins and RNA content to other cells.

records.title: Turning excitons to the dark side
records.description: Hubbard excitons capture the many-body correlations of Mott insulators. Using ultrafast light, their quantum wavefunction can be coherently rotated, opening a path towards optical quantum control and sensing in strongly correlated materials.

records.title: Rapid sintering of ultrafine-grained refractory metals under mild conditions
records.description: The introduction of liquid metals to refractory metals weakens metal bonding, which enables rapid, low-temperature fabrication of refractory metal bulk materials with ultrafine grains, high strength and tunable composition.

records.title: Minimally invasive bioelectronic implants
records.description: Minimally invasive medical procedures are widely used in clinical practice. This Review discusses recent advances in bioelectronic devices that can be implanted using minimally invasive technologies, highlighting innovations in the materials and design to engineer personalized bioelectronic systems.

records.title: Efficient and reversible chirality induction between protein and achiral plasmonic assemblies
records.description: Mechanical modulation of protein conformation enables the reversible induction of strong plasmon-coupled circular dichroism in otherwise achiral plasmonic assemblies.

records.title: An ultrasound-scanning in vivo light source
records.description: A deep-tissue light source made from mechanoluminescent transducers stimulated by focused ultrasound enables wide imaging of live animal vasculature, and modulation of neuronal activity and behaviour.

records.title: Efficient and reversible chirality induction between protein and achiral plasmonic assemblies
records.description: Mechanical modulation of protein conformation enables the reversible induction of strong plasmon-coupled circular dichroism in otherwise achiral plasmonic assemblies.

records.title: An ultrasound-scanning in vivo light source
records.description: A deep-tissue light source made from mechanoluminescent transducers stimulated by focused ultrasound enables wide imaging of live animal vasculature, and modulation of neuronal activity and behaviour.

records.title: Orbital-hybridization-induced Ising-type superconductivity in a confined gallium layer
records.description: Orbital hybridization and quantum confinement are used to realize Ising-like superconductivity in trilayers of gallium, which alone is probably not strongly enough spin–orbit coupled to host such superconductivity under high in-plane magnetic fields.

records.title: All-van der Waals microcavities for low-loss nonlinear photonics
records.description: Photonic components fabricated from van der Waals materials and patterned using focused ion beam lithography with aluminium passivation demonstrate quality factors exceeding 10 6 and an efficient nonlinear optical response.

records.title: Two-dimensional materials for integrated sensing
records.description: Two-dimensional (2D) materials are promising for in situ encoding and optoelectronic sensing in computing technologies. This Review discusses integrated optoelectronic sensing based on 2D materials and future challenges and prospects for integrated sensing encoding information beyond optical signals.

records.title: Bulk nano-heterointerface secures molecular contacts in perovskite solar cells
records.description: The weak contact between the oxide electrode and molecular layer in inverted perovskite solar cells is prone to deformation, limiting long-term device stability. A bulk nano-heterointerface is designed to strengthen the binding force between molecules and spherical silicon oxide nanoparticles, increasing the interfacial contact area and improving the operational stability of perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Hydrogels find their inner magnetism
records.description: Hydrogels containing C=O groups and calcium cations show an unexpected paramagnetic effect that may have biomedical applications.

records.title: Nanophotonic chip-space interfaces for multidimensional nonlinear optics
records.description: Reconfigurable chip-to-free-space interfaces based on thin-film lithium niobate microrings generate on-demand nonlinear structured light, including tunable optical vortices, optical skyrmions and spatiotemporal vortex pulses.

records.title: Static magnetization switching in an artificial antiferromagnetic multilayer driven by a voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy effect
records.description: For conventional voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) switching, a small variation in the pulse widths of the order of several picoseconds can cause switching failure. Now, VCMA-driven static magnetization switching is demonstrated, which is largely insensitive to pulse widths within certain thresholds.

records.title: Removing aluminium impurities in primary magnesium at an ultra-low cost
records.description: Introducing cost-effective CaO removes aluminium impurities in magnesium vapour with over 90% efficiency, enabling the affordable, large-scale production of high-purity magnesium with low aluminium.

records.title: Option for transparent peer review
records.description: Authors whose research paper is accepted for publication at Nature Materials now have the option to include the reviewers’ comments and their rebuttal letters with their publication.

records.title: Tuning phonon transmission via single-atom substituents
records.description: Atomic-level changes to molecular junctions are found to tune the thermal conductance of the junctions by a factor of two. These observations, performed using high-resolution calorimetric scanning tunnelling probes, show how single atoms can influence and control phonon transport in molecular junctions.

records.title: Magnetic drag from frustrated order
records.description: Friction typically scales with load but magnetic systems can defy this rule. Sliding arrays of magnetic rotors reveal that energy dissipation peaks where competing magnetic orders dynamically clash. This non-monotonic magnetic drag arises from sliding-induced hysteresis, offering a blueprint for tunable, contactless braking at any scale.

records.title: Amino acid-derived ionizable lipids enable inhaled base editing for therapeutic gene correction in the lung
records.description: Gene correction in the lung is achieved with inhalable mRNA lipid nanoparticles containing an amino acid-derived ionizable lipid identified from screening and structure–function optimization studies.

records.title: Synthesis of 4H-phase high-entropy alloys for electrocatalysis
records.description: Au nanowires with an unconventional hexagonal close-packed (4H) phase stabilize the 4H-phase high-entropy alloys grown epitaxially on their surface through a facile chemical synthesis. The resulting core–shell nanostructures demonstrate promising overall water electrolysis performance.

records.title: Connecting the dots for cooperative emission
records.description: Both superfluorescence and amplified spontaneous emission are observed in giant perovskite nanocrystals with the transition between these two cooperative emission regimes worked out by tuning temperature, excitation fluence and emitter density.

records.title: Transition between cooperative emission regimes in giant perovskite nanocrystals
records.description: The role of temperature and excitation density in promoting cooperative emission regimes such as superfluorescence and amplified spontaneous emission, as well as the transitions between such regimes in perovskite nanocrystals, is reported.

records.title: Interlayer exciton flux amplification driven by strong exciton confinement
records.description: Nanoscale bandgap tuning in van der Waals heterobilayers using an electro-plasmonic nanocavity provides electrical control of exciton dynamics, producing localized interlayer exciton density gradients and enhanced diffusion currents in the nanoscale.

records.title: The fourfold way to rupture in active solids
records.description: Quadrupolar topological defects act as organization centres for material failure in a biomimetic active nematic solid.

records.title: Anodic protection enables moisture-stable Mg 3 (Sb, Bi) 2 for thermoelectric cooling
records.description: Mg 3 (Sb, Bi) 2 is a potential next-generation thermoelectric with cost-effectiveness compared with Bi 2 Te 3 ; however, it suffers from poor moisture corrosion resistance. Here, an anodic protection strategy is presented that substantially reduces corrosion, enabling the 28-day performance of a module in high-temperature and high-humidity environment.

records.title: Materials with 5 d electrons for future technologies
records.description: Materials with 5 d electrons are receiving increasing attention due to their unique properties and functions. To understand property–function relations, this Perspective analyses six key factors in the electronic structure of 5 d electron materials in a range of application areas.

records.title: Mineral-originated bioelectronics for inhibition via lithium electrochemistry
records.description: A bioelectronic device incorporating triphylite (LiFePO 4 ) as electrode is used for lithium-ion-specific inhibition of peripheral and central nervous system activities in rats and in mice.

records.title: Narrowband helical emitter with frontier orbital confinement for stable deep-blue hybrid-tandem organic light-emitting diodes
records.description: Narrowband deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes combining high colour purity, efficiency and stability are realized by using multiresonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence emitters with a highly twisted helical structure.

records.title: Designing disordered materials beyond equilibrium
records.description: A family of glassy materials emerges from local structural optimization, revealing an unexpected form of long-range orientational order.

records.title: From a same origin to diverse and recyclable materials
records.description: A single monomer can be leveraged to generate polymeric materials with diverse structures or tunable properties and chemical recyclability.

records.title: Entanglement made measurable
records.description: A resonant inelastic X-ray scattering interferometric approach exposes a highly entangled electronic ground state in a pyrochlore iridate, linking quantum entanglement to intertwined symmetry-breaking orders in a correlated metal near a metal–insulator transition.

records.title: A Floquet gap finally opens in graphene
records.description: Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy now resolves the long-sought avoided crossing in light-driven graphene, establishing a practical recipe for Floquet band engineering and sharpening prospects for light-induced topology in quantum materials.

records.title: Observation of Floquet-induced gap in graphene
records.description: Floquet engineering in monolayer graphene reveals a gap opening at Floquet band crossings and coherent Floquet sidebands resolved by time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy.

records.title: Mechanisms of active wetting and fluidification in epithelial cell collectives
records.description: Active wetting and fluidification of breast cancer epithelia are shown to be controlled by IRSp53 and Afadin, cell adhesion proteins that regulate multicellular viscosity and tensile state during tumour progression.

records.title: Perovskite–organic tandem solar cells with superior reverse-bias stability
records.description: Perovskite–organic-based solar cells typically show poor reverse-bias stability. By modulating the deep trap state in the bulk-heterojunction region, organic and perovskite–organic tandem solar cells show largely improved stability under reverse biases up to –40 V.

records.title: Three-dimensional photonic topological insulators go unbounded
records.description: Three-dimensional all-dielectric photonic topological insulators are experimentally shown to control far-field emission via the pseudo-spin degree of freedom.

records.title: A hydrogel-based iontronic-reservoir-enabled neuromorphic prosthetic system
records.description: We developed a hydrogel-based iontronic reservoir system as a neuromorphic neuroprosthesis. It achieved more than 90% accuracy on multiple recognition tasks, muscle fatigue sensing via pH-responsive dynamics of its self-healing hydrogels, and rapid and robust functional recovery (0.02 s). The system supported adaptive closed-loop neural stimulation in vivo based on voice commands and muscle states.

records.title: Optically detected nuclear magnetic resonance of coherent spins in a molecular complex
records.description: Optical initialization and read-out of nuclear spins with a spin coherence time of 2 ms in a Eu 3+ molecular crystal is demonstrated with radio-frequency control, providing coherent nuclear spin manipulation for quantum information technologies.

records.title: Multiscale phase nucleation driven by photoinduced polarons in a volume-changing material
records.description: Photoinduced phase transitions in a Prussian blue analogue are studied using femtosecond X-ray techniques, revealing a multistep phase nucleation process with photoinduced polarons triggering the macroscopic phase transformation.

records.title: Author Correction: Mitigating proton trapping in cubic perovskite oxides via ScO 6 octahedral networks
Author Correction: An iontronic reservoir for highly robust neuromorphic prosthesis
Non-monotonic magnetic friction from collective rotor dynamics
records.description: The forces and dissipative losses of an array of rotatable magnets moving above a commensurate array of fixed macroscopic magnets are measured. Modelling and analysis show a maximum of dissipation at an intermediate distance where ferro- and antiferromagnetic order compete.

records.title: Linking metal oxidation to oxygen reactivity
records.description: Using multiple spectroscopies, it is shown that water oxidation on iridium oxides is driven by accumulated oxygen ligand holes.

records.title: Conventional wisdom about threshold switches challenged
records.description: Nanoscaled selectors made of elemental selenium that show picoampere-level leakage current and an on/off ratio of 10 8 call for rethinking electrical transport mechanisms.

records.title: Gold-activated persulfate p-doping of organic semiconductors
records.description: Achieving lateral doping gradients in organic semiconductors (OSCs) via solution processing is crucial but remains a challenge. A gold-activated persulfate doping strategy can locally oxidize OSCs and create a lateral doping gradient, enabling low contact resistance and high carrier mobility in solution-processed organic field-effect transistors.

records.title: Crosslinked ionizable lipids reprogram dendritic cell metabolism for potent mRNA vaccination
records.description: Lipid nanoparticles incorporating a crosslinked ionizable lipid are shown to promote efficient endosomal escape of antigen mRNA and glycolysis stimulation in dendritic cells, to elicit robust vaccination against viruses and cancer.

records.title: Pyroptosis-boosting nanoadjuvants enable effective in situ cancer vaccination
records.description: We developed a nanoadjuvant platform that targets early endosome membranes in tumour cells, triggering their pyroptosis and the release of pyroptosomes, which act as an in situ vaccine against the tumour. In preclinical cancer models featuring multiple metastases, this nanoplatform enabled spatiotemporal induction of robust immune responses, resulting in systemic tumour eradication and long-lasting antitumour immunity.

records.title: A nanoporous capacitive electrochemical ratchet for continuous ion separations
records.description: An ion pump that does not require redox reactions to drive aqueous ions against forces is demonstrated, and may find applications in selective ion separation and water desalination.

records.title: Grain boundary stabilization of fluorite ferroelectrics
records.description: Electron microscopy and spectroscopy, together with electronic structure calculations, are used to show that orbital ordering of ions at grain boundaries can facilitate the stabilization of ferroelectric phases.

records.title: Pathways to commercially viable organic photovoltaic materials
records.description: Low-cost, efficient and stable materials are required to enable the widespread application of organic photovoltaics. In this Review, the challenges associated with designing low-cost materials, developing eco-friendly solvents and understanding intrinsic degradation mechanisms of organic photovoltaics are discussed.

records.title: Enriched membrane stackings made possible
records.description: A sacrificial layer with hexagonal symmetry is reported that can be used to peel and delaminate oxide substrates with hexagonal symmetry and beyond.

records.title: Prediction of rheological properties via structure elucidation of solvated hydrogels
records.description: Liquid-cell transmission electron microscopy is used to investigate the network structure of cellulosic gels. The formation of nano- and microscale fibrillar bundles is observed, providing insight into structure–property relationships in hydrogels.

records.title: Unravel the complexity
records.description: Fitting the resistance fluctuation data with a hidden Markov model helps uncover the complex free energy landscape and understand the glass relaxation dynamics of a phase-change material, GeTe.

records.title: Stress-relaxing granular bioprinting materials enable complex and uniform organoid self-organization
records.description: A tunable granular biomaterial matrix is developed to support long-term bioprinting. Stress relaxation at high strains and long timescales is shown to be important for tissue self-organization in intestinal organoids.

records.title: Two-dimensional crystalline hard masks for high-aspect-ratio nanofabrication
records.description: Van der Waals metal oxyhalides demonstrate high resistance to aggressive plasma etching, precise patternability and mechanical transferability, enabling high-aspect-ratio nanofabrication across diverse substrates.

records.title: Room-temperature two-dimensional multiferroic metal with voltage-controllable magnetic order
records.description: Bilayer CrTe 2 films grown via molecular beam epitaxy are found to host room-temperature multiferroicity and strong magnetoelectric coupling.

records.title: An iontronic reservoir for highly robust neuromorphic prosthesis
records.description: Achieving robustness against a dynamic physiological environment is a challenge for neuromorphic prostheses. An interface made of a self-healing hydrogel and electrodes acts as a physical reservoir of a neuromorphic prosthesis, achieving minimal susceptibility to physical damage.

records.title: Proton shuttle-assisted triplet energy transfer
records.description: Proton-coupled energy transfer has only been observed with singlet-exciton transfer. A net process of spin-triplet migration is observed in photoexcited colloidal quantum dots with surface-anchored molecular moieties, establishing a proton shuttle-assisted triplet energy transfer.

records.title: Quantum control of Hubbard excitons
records.description: Floquet engineering is emerging as a tool to control quantum materials. Here it is applied using non-resonant optical fields to coherently dress Hubbard excitons in Sr 2 CuO 3 , driving wavefunction rotations between bright and dark states.

records.title: Magnon confinement in epitaxial antiferromagnetic oxide heterostructures
records.description: Magnon transport is confined to a plane by sandwiching BiFeO 3 between layers of non-polar antiferromagnetic LaFeO 3 , resulting in efficient magnon transport and a higher voltage output through spin–charge conversion that can be controlled using electric fields. These results have implications for electric-field-controlled spin-based memory and logic elements.

records.title: Heterogeneity by design
records.description: Heterogeneous microstructure engineering has become a powerful strategy for optimizing properties and performance of metallic alloys.

records.title: Dynamical stability by spin transfer in nearly isotropic magnets
records.description: Spin torques generated via the spin-Hall effect in CoFeB/W/MgO are found to stabilize magnetization in a high-energy anti-parallel state relative to an applied magnetic field. This observation serves as a platform for studying far-from-equilibrium spin dynamics and holds promise for realizing unconventional computing paradigms.

records.title: In situ-generated vaccine-like pyroptosome for personalized cancer immunotherapy
records.description: An injectable pH-sensitive nanoadjuvant is shown to induce effective pyroptosis of tumours, which, combined with the in situ photoactivable release of TLR agonists, generates a strong vaccine-like response to eradicate the tumour.

records.title: Texture-dependent all-optical switching in ferromagnetic films via stochastic nucleation of nanoscale domains
records.description: Faraday microscopy and magnetic force microscopy with circularly polarized picosecond optical pulses are used to investigate domain switching in a ferromagnetic Pt/Co/Pt thin film. A stochastic model explains the nucleation and growth of magnetic domains, taking into account light helicity and the relative magnetization of neighbouring domains.

records.title: Efficient two-photon emission from a quantum dot
records.description: Reliable control over photon number is essential for scalable quantum photonics, yet producing well-defined two-photon emission from quantum emitters remains challenging. Now, by exploiting a dark-state pathway to biexciton population in a quantum-dot microcavity, bright high-purity photon pairs have been generated, offering a promising route towards practical two-photon sources.

records.title: Stability in the dilute limit
records.description: Highly dilute metal dopants arrest nanoparticle sintering by electronically stabilizing a few critical surface atoms, redefining how catalyst stability can be engineered at the atomic scale.

records.title: Metal hybridization in dilute-alloy catalysts promotes sintering resistance by decreasing surface mobility
records.description: Single-atom alloys can exhibit unique catalytic properties. Here, using reactivity measurements, atomic-scale imaging, simulation and spectroscopic analysis, it is shown that 1 atom% addition of Pt to Cu nanoparticles substantially decreases deactivation in single-atom alloys via sintering. A general predictive model of catalyst stabilization is developed.

records.title: Charge-triggered switching mechanism in selenium selector enabling ultralow leakage current
records.description: Phase-change memories require effective ovonic threshold switching (OTS) selectors to eliminate leakage currents. A charge-triggered switching mechanism is identified in amorphous elemental selenium and shown to make it an effective OTS selector that can achieve a leakage current of 4 × 10 −12 A.

records.title: Purcell-enhanced two-photon emission from a quantum dot via dark-state biexciton loading
records.description: Resonant p -shell excitation of a Purcell-enhanced In(Ga)As quantum dot–micropillar system enables efficient biexciton loading, leading to efficient two-photon emission with strong two-photon correlations and a high two-photon fraction.

records.title: Deeper insights into charge photogeneration in organic solar cells
records.description: An advanced model is developed to pinpoint the parameters that control the bulk charge photogeneration yield and to provide design strategies for highly efficient organic solar cells.

records.title: Molecular factors controlling charge pair generation in organic photovoltaic materials
records.description: A model is devised to investigate free charge generation in neat acceptor domains and at donor–acceptor heterojunctions. Efficient photocurrent generation in organic heterojunctions at low energetic offsets can be related to key molecular parameters and to electronic state delocalization.

records.title: Engineering phase-frustration-induced flat bands in an aza-triangulene covalent kagome lattice
records.description: The on-surface synthesis of π -conjugated covalent organic frameworks (COFs) enables the realization of designer quantum nanomaterials. Orbital-phase frustration within an aza-triangulene COF-based kagome lattice is reported to give rise to non-trivial flat bands.

records.title: A modern perspective on antiferroelectrics
records.description: Antiferroelectrics possess an antipolar ground state, and can be electrically driven into a polar phase. This Perspective discusses the history of these systems, defines these materials, surveys different types of antiferroelectricity and presents an outlook on future research pathways.

records.title: Key role of oxidizing species driving water oxidation revealed by time-resolved optical and X-ray spectroscopies
records.description: Iridium oxide is a state-of-the-art catalyst for green hydrogen production, but the identity of species present under operating conditions remains debated. Here, using multiple operando spectroscopy approaches with time-resolution, water oxidation is found to be driven by O −1 states.

records.title: How ions squeeze water out of n-type ladder organic mixed conductors
records.description: Unlike common organic mixed ionic–electronic conductors that swell upon electrochemical doping, poly(benzimidazobenzophenanthroline) exhibits an unexpected cation-dependent deswelling at high doping levels. Operando measurements and modelling show that protic cations drive this response by expelling water and localizing charge through strong interactions with the polymer backbone, revealing a distinct deswelling mechanism.

records.title: Topological control of spontaneous failure in active nematic solids
records.description: Topological defect quadrupoles orchestrate predictable failure patterns in active nematic solid networks.

records.title: An ångström-scale Janus aperture as a gas flow rectifier
records.description: Gas transport through an ångström-sized Janus aperture in graphene, which is created by ozone etching, is investigated by using high-resolution transport measurements and high-throughput atomistic simulations. Rectified gas flow for various gases is demonstrated with rectification ratios of up to two orders of magnitude for oxygen.

records.title: Altermagnetic multiferroics with symmetry-locked magnetoelectric coupling
records.description: We discuss altermagnetic multiferroics, materials hosting distinct advantages for low-power spintronic devices, including a zero net magnetization that eliminates stray fields, a momentum-dependent spin splitting enabling controllable spin currents and an intrinsic strong magnetoelectric coupling originating from the spin space symmetry.

records.title: Six-state clock physics in an atomically thin antiferromagnet
records.description: Nonlinear optical micropolarimetry and atomistic Monte Carlo simulations of monolayer NiPS 3 evidence a Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless phase that, with decreasing temperature, gives way to long-range order consistent with a six-state clock model.

records.title: Crystal-facet-directed all-vacuum-deposited perovskite solar cells
records.description: The vacuum process is scalable and solvent free, yet all-vacuum-deposited perovskite solar cells still trail solution-processed counterparts. Facet-directed co-evaporation yields (100)-oriented mixed-halide wide-bandgap films for efficient, stable single-junction cells and perovskite–silicon tandem cells.

records.title: Interface complexes unlock ultrahigh-strength martensite
records.description: A martensitic medium-entropy alloy surpasses the long-standing strength–ductility ceiling of conventional ultrahigh-strength steels. The strengthening without sacrificing ductility originates from Mo–B–C interface complexes that stabilize small-angle grain boundaries.

records.title: Ultralow contact resistance in halide perovskite devices
records.description: A charge transfer between metal oxide and halide perovskites occurring beneath the metal contact surface locally dopes the semiconductor, dramatically reducing contact resistance and enabling efficient low-voltage charge injection.

records.title: Bulk-heterojunction doping in lead halide perovskites for low-resistance metal contacts
records.description: Through van der Waals integration of Ag/Au electrodes onto single-crystal CsPbBr 3 thin films and subsequent formation of Ag 2 O/CsPbBr 3 bulk heterojunctions, effective interfacial hole doping is achieved, reducing the contact resistance by two orders of magnitude compared with previously reported contacts of similar composition.

records.title: Restoring the tumour mechanophenotype of vocal fold cancer reverts its malignant properties
records.description: Vocal fold cancer tumours lose some of their malignant traits when mechanically stimulated by physiological stretch or vibrations, mimicking the opening and closing of vocal folds and phonation.

records.title: A molten-salt dispersion of lanthanides at the atomic scale
records.description: Persistent synthesis challenges constrain the stabilization of single-atom lanthanide catalysts across many substrates. Using a method based on molten-nitrite chemistry, the atomic dispersion of lanthanide atoms on diverse substrates is achieved and exemplified by Dy 1 /Pt for acidic hydrogen evolution.

records.title: Radioisotope-mimetic molecular afterglow probe for downregulated cancer biomarker imaging
records.description: A probe with month-long molecular afterglow luminescence targeting a downregulated cancer biomarker detects small liver tumours for image-guided resection in mice and rabbits.

records.title: Multiscale-structured miniaturized 3D force sensors
records.description: Tactile sensing to differentiate normal and shear forces remains a challenge. A force microsensor array based on graphene and a liquid-metal composites decouples normal–shear force sensing, achieving a 200 μm scale and a 0.9 μN force detection limit.

records.title: Reconstructing into a denser phase
records.description: Tellurium vacancies can drive atomic reconstruction in PdTe 2 thin films, converting them into non-layered PdTe. Such a non-stoichiometric phase transition yields large-scale thin-film superconductors and can also create an intermediate heterostructure that enables helicity-sensitive terahertz emission.

records.title: Ideal non-crystals as a distinct form of ordered states without symmetry breaking
records.description: A distinct class of ordered states without symmetry breaking is reported with perfect non-crystalline steric order. These ideal non-crystals exhibit non-trivial long-range orientational correlations and crystal-like properties.

records.title: Helical metasurfaces based on topological surface states in three-dimensional photonic topological insulators
records.description: The open interfaces of a three-dimensional all-dielectric photonic topological insulator operate as effective metasurfaces with helical surface states, enabling spin-dependent steering and directional control of far-field surface state emission.

records.title: Diverse polymers with chemical recyclability via regioirregular polymerization of a single monomer
records.description: Using a regioirregular polymerization strategy, diverse polymer structures containing urethane, carbonate and urea linkages are synthesized from a single tetramethylene urethane monomer. Mixed polymers can be depolymerized to the starting monomer in a closed-loop manner.

records.title: Cation–polymer interactions drive water expulsion and deswelling in n-type ladder organic mixed conductors
records.description: A molecular-level understanding of structural evolution upon electrochemical doping in organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors is required. A pronounced reduction in mass and thickness is observed in an n-type ladder polymer upon doping with protic cations owing to water expulsion.

records.title: Ultraclean monolayers from a van der Waals confinement
records.description: Growing transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers at a buried van der Waals interface simultaneously improves thickness control, preserves ultraclean interfaces, and enables intrinsic patterning and atomically selective Janus structure formation.

records.title: Atomically precise synthesis and simultaneous heterostructure integration of 2D transition metal dichalcogenides through nano-confinement
records.description: Nano-confinement between a capping layer composed of graphene or hexagonal boron nitride and a substrate directs the growth kinetics during chemical vapour deposition, which enables the atomically precise synthesis of 2D transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers, Janus monolayers and van der Waals heterostructures with ultraclean interfaces.

records.title: Narrowband quantum emitters with optically addressable spin states generated in hexagonal boron nitride
records.description: A single-step thermal process reliably generates high-density, narrowband quantum emitters in hexagonal boron nitride. More than 25% of these emitters show room-temperature optical spin readout, revealing S = 1 and S = 1/2 spin complexes that are explained by charge transfer from strongly to weakly coupled spin pairs.

records.title: Author Correction: How charge frustration causes ion ordering and microphase separation at surfaces
The dynamic frontier of artificial intelligence
records.description: As artificial intelligence tools continue to develop, their impact is growing.

records.title: A 3-GPa ductile martensitic alloy enabled by interface complexes and dislocations
records.description: A martensitic alloy with a tensile strength exceeding 3 GPa and a fracture elongation of 5.13% is developed. These mechanical properties arise from interface complexes interacting with dense dislocation networks, which is a mechanism shown to be applicable to other compositions.

records.title: A free energy landscape analysis of resistance fluctuations in a memristive device
records.description: Resistance noise in memristive devices is often described as a thermally activated process across simple energy barriers, but this can underestimate the role of entropy in a complex free energy landscape. Quantifying transition rates between discrete resistance states during resistance fluctuations in nanoscale GeTe shows that entropic contributions can strongly shape the free energy barriers.

records.title: Scalable manufacture of nearly pure-phase metallic MoS 2 nanosheets
records.description: A microwave-assisted process is developed for the rapid and scalable manufacture of pure-phase metallic MoS 2 nanosheets, enabling practical electrochemical devices for energy applications.

records.title: Water-soluble hexagonal BaAl 2 O 4 as sacrificial layer for freestanding crystalline membranes and flexible devices
records.description: Freestanding membranes of hexagonal oxides remain difficult to obtain. In this work, a water-soluble crystalline hexagonal BaAl 2 O 4 is found to serve as a sacrificial layer for obtaining freestanding membranes with six-fold or three-fold symmetry.

records.title: Collective photon emission and ferroelectric exciton ordering near Mott insulating state in WSe 2 /WS 2 heterobilayers
records.description: Ferroelectric ordering of moiré excitons and collective photon emission emerge in WSe 2 /WS 2 heterobilayers near the Mott state driven by strong dipolar interactions and a transition to symmetry-broken ferroelectric phases.

records.title: Revealing key structures for reversible sulfur redox in amorphous polymeric sulfur
records.description: Amorphous sulfurized polyacrylonitrile suppresses polysulfide shuttling in Li–S batteries, enabling long cycle life, but the structural processes involved during synthesis and initial cycling remained unclear. An operando pair distribution function, wide-angle scattering and sulfur absorption spectroscopy reveal S–C bond formation, π–π stacking and sulfur-chain shortening, which enable reversible sulfur redox.

records.title: Unexpected strong paramagnetism of hydrogels containing carbon–oxygen double bonds induced by calcium cations
records.description: Strong paramagnetism is generated in hydrogels rich in carbon–oxygen double bonds simply by coupling with diamagnetic Ca cations. These paramagnetic hydrogels are applied as magnetic resonance imaging contrast agents and magnetic drug carriers.

records.title: Exploiting and taming the structural instability for computer memories
records.description: A phase-change material enables in-memory computing by well-controlled multilevel switching without resistance drift.

records.title: Intertwined orders in a quantum-entangled metal
records.description: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering interferometry reveals a highly entangled electronic phase in Nd 2 Ir 2 O 7 , enabling extraction of its entanglement structure and confirming the cubic-symmetry-breaking order predicted from complementary Raman spectroscopy.

records.title: Narrowband quantum emitters in hexagonal boron nitride with optically addressable spins
records.description: Producing isolated single-photon emitters in hexagonal boron nitride with predefined spin transitions is challenging. Oxygen annealing enables the controlled fabrication of narrowband quantum emitters with optically active spin for quantum applications.

records.title: The paradoxes of interfacial electrolyte structures
records.description: Charge frustration emerges as a key factor to explain the formation of overcharged ion structures next to an electrified surface.

records.title: Achieving high tensile strength and ductility in refractory alloys by tuning electronic structure
records.description: Guided by density functional theory, a commercially viable refractory alloy is developed, which exhibits excellent room-temperature ductility and strength, and high strength at elevated temperatures.

records.title: How charge frustration causes ion ordering and microphase separation at surfaces
records.description: Atomic force microscopy is used to investigate the adsorption and organization of ions on charged surfaces. Trivalent ions adopt complex networks, clusters and layers associated with overcharging, whereas divalent ions follow classical predictions.

records.title: Leveraging the power of metasurfaces
records.description: Metasurfaces and metamaterials (or meta-optics) and their optoelectronic hybrid integration are set to drive the next era of computing, sensing and communications. As electronic systems reach fundamental limits, optical-enabled artificial intelligence emerges as a way forward, with meta-optics enabling speed, efficiency and scalability. We argue the need for comprehensive national innovation strategies to exploit the value of meta-optics in the photonics industry.

records.title: Higgs mode-driven phase transitions in two-dimensional perovskites
records.description: A study of phase transitions in two-dimensional halide perovskites uncovers distinct thermal and optical pathways through Ginzburg–Landau theory. The work identifies an optically driven metastable tetragonal phase, excited by Higgs phonon modes, offering insights into symmetry-breaking dynamics.

records.title: Long-range chemical signalling in vivo is regulated by mechanical signals
records.description: Tissue stiffness mediated by Piezo1 is shown to regulate the expression of diffusive guidance cues in the developing Xenopus laevis brain, revealing a crosstalk between mechanical signals and long-range chemical signalling.

records.title: Cell viscosity influences haematogenous dissemination and metastatic extravasation of tumour cells
records.description: The viscosity of tumour cells is shown to govern their ability to disseminate through the bloodstream and extravasate, establishing a key biomechanical factor of metastasis.

records.title: Mechanical behaviour of additively manufactured metals
records.description: The non-equilibrium processing conditions inherent to additive manufacturing produce metals with unique microstructures and mechanical properties that are often unattainable through conventional routes. This Review provides an overview of distinctive mechanical behaviours and deformation mechanisms that arise from these characteristic microstructures, and discusses critical needs and emerging opportunities for alloy design and processing control to achieve exceptional mechanical properties in additively manufactured metals.

records.title: Large-area non-stoichiometric phase transition in transition metal chalcogenide films
records.description: Controllable and scalable phase transition of transition metal chalcogenides is challenging. Using in situ microscopic analysis, a non-stoichiometric phase transition from PdTe 2 to PdTe is observed on the atomic scale, providing mechanistic insights into the scalable phase engineering of transition metal chalcogenide films and heterostructures.

records.title: Heterogeneous doping via nanoscale coating impacts the mechanics of Li intrusion in brittle solid electrolytes
records.description: Short-circuiting during fast charging through lithium dendrite intrusion into electrolytes is a major challenge in solid-state batteries. Here, using thermally annealed 3-nm-thick Ag coatings, lithium penetration into brittle electrolyte Li 6.6 La 3 Zr 1.6 Ta 0.4 O 12 is inhibited at local current densities of 250 mA cm −2 due to an increase in surface fracture toughness.

records.title: Biomolecular condensates as electrochemical powerhouses
records.description: Biomaterials capable of driving electrochemical reactions could unlock next-generation, purely biological bioelectronics. However, fully genetically encodable biomaterials for this purpose have been missing. Now, protein condensates can be programmed to be electrogenic, powering redox reactions and functioning as intracellular electrochemical reactors.

records.title: Electrogenic protein condensates as intracellular electrochemical reactors
records.description: Protein condensates are engineered with tunable interfacial electric fields to drive electrochemical reactions, serving as a biomaterial platform for intrinsic electrogenic materials.

records.title: Quasi-non-volatile capacitorless DRAM based on ultralow-leakage edge-contact MoS 2 transistors
records.description: An in situ multistep edge-contact process is developed for MoS 2 transistors, achieving quasi-non-volatile capacitorless two-transistor dynamic random-access memory with 5-bit accuracy and nanosecond write speeds.

records.title: Nonlinear phase-matched van der Waals crystals integrated on optical fibres
records.description: Integration of twist-phase-matched van der Waals flakes on optical fibre ends enables efficient nonlinear optical processes, including second-harmonic generation and parametric downconversion, and the fabrication of a frequency-doubling ultrafast laser.

records.title: Designing heterostructured materials
records.description: Heterostructured materials can exhibit superior performance compared with their homogeneous counterparts. This Perspective discusses the fundamental effects of heterostructural features, methods for evaluating these effects and practical considerations for guiding the design of heterostructured materials.

records.title: Experimental observation of liquid–solid transition of nanoconfined water at ambient temperature
records.description: A combination of scanning probe microscopy and quantum sensing is used to investigate changes in water structure under confinement. A liquid–solid phase transition is observed in thin films of water below a confinement size of 2 nm at ambient temperature.

records.title: Wafer-scale monolayer dielectric integration on atomically thin semiconductors
records.description: Wafer-scale monolayer MoO 3 enables the integration of dielectrics with ultralow capacitance equivalent thickness on atomically thin semiconductors, achieving high yield and effective operation of n-type and p-type top-gated transistors.

records.title: Flexible two-dimensional neural sensors
records.description: Two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide arrays fabricated at wafer scale directly on a flexible substrate create large arrays of dual transistor devices for high sensitivity and multiplexed neural monitoring.

records.title: Gate structuring on n-type bilayer MoS 2 field-effect transistors for ultrahigh current density
records.description: A dual-gate structure in bilayer MoS 2 FETs is reported, allowing a high carrier density by compensating for the fringing field, which holds promise for 2D semiconductor logic applications.

records.title: Electrically writing a magnetic heliknoton in a chiral magnet
records.description: Magnetic heliknotons are hopfions embedded in helical spin backgrounds. Current-induced nucleation and Hall-effect-free motion of isolated magnetic heliknotons is demonstrated in the chiral magnet FeGe.

records.title: Monolithic cell-on-memristor architecture enables wafer-scale integration of oscillatory chemoreceptors for bio-realistic gustatory chips
records.description: The fabrication of conventional artificial chemoreceptors are difficult to scale up. Here a wafer scale cell-on-memristor chemoreceptive array is reported, allowing for self-powered biosensing and in situ spike encoding.

records.title: All-nitride superconducting qubits based on atomic layer deposition
records.description: NbN/AlN/NbN qubits prepared by atomic layer deposition allow for precise control of the tunnelling barrier and stable operation beyond the temperature limit of aluminium-based devices.

records.title: Imaging supermoiré relaxation in helical trilayer graphene
records.description: A scanning single-electron transistor is used to probe the strain dependence of moiré and supermoiré domains. It is observed that these can be considered nearly independent of each other.

records.title: A metastable tetragonal phase in two-dimensional halide perovskite lattices driven by a coherent Higgs mode
records.description: Light-induced phonon dynamics in 2D (BA) 2 PbI 4 films reveal transient lattice shifts to a tetragonal phase, driven by Higgs-mode vibrations. Below-bandgap excitation causes larger spectral shifts, showing strong optomechanical coupling in perovskites.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-driven approaches for materials design and discovery
records.description: Computational approaches to materials design promise to accelerate the discovery of materials with superior functionalities. This Review presents key computational advances in materials design over the past few decades, highlighting the paradigm shift from conventional screening approaches to inverse generation driven by deep generative models. Current challenges and future perspectives of materials inverse design are also discussed.

records.title: Rational design of high-performance low-loading oxygen reduction catalysts for alkaline fuel cells
records.description: Volcano plots are useful catalyst design tools for acidic oxygen reduction reaction, but have proved less successful for alkaline oxygen reduction reaction. Here, a modified volcano plot for this environment is developed and used to design PdH x @Pt nanosheets with high oxygen reduction reaction performance.
